# anydoc

[![Crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/anydoc.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/anydoc)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@firecrawl/anydoc.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@firecrawl/anydoc)
[![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/firecrawl-anydoc.svg)](https://pypi.org/project/firecrawl-anydoc/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/firecrawl/anydoc)](https://skills.sh/firecrawl/anydoc)

Fast Rust library that converts documents (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF) into clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown. Includes bindings for [Node.js](node/README.md), [Python](python/README.md), and the [browser](wasm/README.md) (WebAssembly).

Built by [Firecrawl](https://firecrawl.dev) to turn any office document into LLM-ready Markdown in single-digit milliseconds, with one consistent output no matter which format goes in. It powers [Firecrawl Parse](https://firecrawl.dev/parse), so if you'd rather not run it yourself, the hosted API gives you the same conversion plus our OCR models for the scanned pages anydoc can't read on its own.

**[Try it in your browser](https://firecrawl.github.io/anydoc/)**: the demo page runs the library as WebAssembly, so files are converted locally and never leave your machine.

## Quick start

### Agent skill

anydoc ships as an [Agent Skill](https://agentskills.io), so your agent can read any document it runs into:

```bash
npx skills add firecrawl/anydoc
```

The [skill](skills/convert-documents-to-markdown/SKILL.md) teaches the agent to convert documents with the anydoc CLI. Works with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code), [Codex](https://openai.com/codex/), [Cursor](https://cursor.com), [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai), and any other [compatible agent](https://agentskills.io/clients).

### CLI

```bash
npx @firecrawl/anydoc report.docx               # Markdown to stdout
npx @firecrawl/anydoc slides.pptx -o slides.md  # or to a file
npx @firecrawl/anydoc - --format csv < data.csv # read stdin
npx @firecrawl/anydoc scan.pdf --ocr hosted     # scanned pages via Firecrawl Parse
```

`npx` downloads the prebuilt binary for your platform on first run. For a permanent `anydoc` command, install globally with `npm install -g @firecrawl/anydoc`. Run `anydoc --help` for all options.

### Node.js

```bash
npm install @firecrawl/anydoc
```

```js
import { toDocument, toMarkdown, toMarkdownBytes } from '@firecrawl/anydoc';

// From a file path:
const markdown = await toMarkdown('report.docx');

// To enable OCR:
const markdown = await toMarkdown('report.docx', { ocr: 'hosted' );

// From bytes, with the format detected from the content:
const fromBytes = await toMarkdownBytes(bytes);

// Or name it, which signature-less formats (CSV) need:
const fromCsv = await toMarkdownBytes(bytes, 'csv');

// Or stop at the document model, which also carries embedded assets:
const document = await toDocument(bytes);
```

| Layer | Target | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **A** | Invisible Unicode, exotic spaces, bidi, tag chars | Deterministic Python scripts |
| **B** | Statistical (token-sampling) text watermarks | Agent rewrite + optional `rewrite_text.py` hook |
| **Files** | C2PA / EXIF / XMP / doc props | PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, BMP, GIF, TIFF, SVG, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, ODT, HTML, Markdown, MP4/MOV/M4A/M4V, WAV, MP3, FLAC |

Vendors / ecosystems (class-level): **Claude**, **Gemini / SynthID-Text**, **OpenAI** provenance surfaces, **open-LLM** Kirchenbauer-style (green-list) and keyed-Gumbel / EXP (Aaronson) marks.

**Latest release:** [v0.7.0](https://github.com/guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover/releases/tag/v0.7.0)

Skill path: [`skills/remove-ai-marks/`](skills/remove-ai-marks/)  
Service path: [`service/`](service/)  
(migration: formerly `remove-claude-marks`; slash alias `/remove-claude-marks` still documented)

## Install (agent skill)

The skill ships **no code** — it calls the service over HTTP. Install the skill (markdown only) and start the service, then set `WATERMARKS_SERVICE_URL` if it is not `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.

deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.content: # DeepSeek Harness English | [中文](README.zh.md) DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by [DeepSeek AI](https://deepseek.com). It is built on an **everything-is-a-plugin** architecture and powered by [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis), whose design is described in [_A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25512). Documentation: [https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) ## Developer preview DeepSeek Harness is in _developer preview_ and iterating rapidly. **THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES.** Review the [safety notice](SAFETY.md) before running the project. ## Run ### Run from `npm` Install `Node.js`, then run: ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web ``` The command starts the Web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080` by default and opens it in the default browser for a local launch. An SSH launch only prints the host URL because the SSH client or editor owns the local forwarded address. Pass `--no-open` to run the server without opening a browser. See [Web UI guide](docs/user/guide/index.md). ### Run from source To run from a repository checkout: ```sh git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git cd deepseek-harness pnpm install pnpm run build pnpm dsh web ``` `pnpm run build` prepares the repository artifacts. `pnpm dsh web` uses those built artifacts without rebuilding. ## Community and support - Submit feedback or bug reports through [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions). - Add the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic to your plugin repository for discoverability. - Join DeepSeek Harness Discord community. ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Development Start with the [development guide](docs/development.md) and [architecture documentation](docs/architecture.md). `pnpm run dev:web` builds, serves, and rebuilds client bundles on source edits in one terminal, and `make help` lists the matching Make targets for Web and Desktop; the guide's application commands section owns the full table. For agents, follow [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). ## Citation ```bibtex @misc{deepseek-harness2026, title={DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin}, author={DeepSeek-AI}, year={2026}, publisher={GitHub}, howpublished={\url{https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness}}, } ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE) Third-party dependencies and their licenses are disclosed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

Unlock datacenter-class intelligence on the hardware you already own — Run 290B+ frontier MoE models locally on your gaming PC at blistering interactive speeds. ## About FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving engine designed for running frontier-scale open-weight models on personal and consumer hardware. It treats heterogeneous edge resources—GPUs, CPUs, host memory, and interconnects—as a unified, elastic inference platform. Its core features include: - **Fast Edge-Native Runtime**: Provides efficient MoE serving with bandwidth-adaptive CPU–GPU co-execution ($q^\star$ policy), full-layer double-buffered prefill streaming, global LRU expert caching, graph-compatible execution, and the FTW fast weight format. - **Semantic-Aware Caching**: Features semantic anchor checkpoints for recurrent state and KV caches, allowing agentic context edits (e.g., tool calls, thinking blocks) to avoid redundant context recomputation. - **Elastic Memory Management**: Supports dynamic, runtime VRAM re-allocation between expert caches and KV memory without engine restarts or weight reloading. - **Broad MoE & Ecosystem Support**: Supports frontier open-weight MoE models (e.g., DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, GLM-5.2) across various parameter scales and quantization formats (e.g., MXFP4, NVFP4, FP8, BF16), with Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible APIs for seamless integration with real-world coding and tool-calling agents (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw, DeepSeek Harness). - **Diverse Consumer Hardware**: Scales across consumer laptops, gaming desktops, and workstation GPUs, with native support for NVIDIA RTX 30, RTX 40, and RTX 50 series GPUs. ## Getting Started ### Desktop app Download FreeToken for Windows or Linux at [flashml.ai](https://www.flashml.ai/). browser-use/jev-ultrafast.content: # Jev Ultrafast ⚡ > [!IMPORTANT] > **BU Ultrafast, Browser Use Cloud's own hosted agent, is live on every plan.** Set `model: "bu-ultrafast"` to use it. > **[Learn more](https://browser-use.com/ultrafast?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=jev-ultrafast)** · **[Open Browser Use Cloud](https://cloud.browser-use.com?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=jev-ultrafast)** **A browser agent with a dynamic, indexed action space.** Give it one goal. [TypeSafe's Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction) picks an operation and an element. A small LLM writes text only when the operation is `TYPE_TEXT`. **Zürich → London on Google Flights in 7.1 seconds.** One natural-language goal, actual text generation, and loading waits included. [Watch the MP4](docs/demo.mp4) · [Measurements](docs/performance.md) · [Read the loop](jev_ultrafast/agent.py) ## The action space Every observation produces a new element table: ```text [1] button Change ticket type · Round trip [2] combobox Where from? · San Francisco [3] combobox Where to? · empty [4] textbox Departure · empty ... ``` The operations are `CLICK`, `TYPE_TEXT`, `SELECT`, `SCROLL_UP`, `SCROLL_DOWN`, `WAIT`, `DONE`, and `BLOCKED`. Only supported operations and targets are offered. ```text one TypeSafe request ┌───────────────────────────┐ page → element table → operation │ │ click_target │ │ type_text_target │ │ select_target, if present │ └─────────────┬─────────────┘ use the matching target │ CLICK [7] ─────┤──→ browser TYPE_TEXT [3] ─────┘ ↓ small LLM → text → browser ``` Target questions are speculative. If the operation is `CLICK`, only `click_target` can execute. Two decisions, **one network round trip**. Each target head contains only compatible elements. Native dropdown choices carry an observed element/option index. There are no site-specific action scripts or prepared field strings in the policy. The Flights example supplies a goal and independently verifies the outcome. The screenshot renderer adds labels afterward; it does not drive the browser. ## Try it ```bash git clone https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast.git cd jev-ultrafast uv sync cp .env.example .env # Add TYPESAFE_API_KEY and TEXT_MODEL_API_KEY. uv run jev ``` Open **http://127.0.0.1:8766** and click **Start demo → Run automatically**. robbietilton/Compositor.content:
# Compositor

Adobe Photoshop costs too much and tools like GIMP don’t feel familiar enough for me to stay in flow. That’s why I built Compositor.

The goal was to create a full-featured image editor that is completely free and open source. I used to use Photoshop for compositing and post-processing, so Compositor is built around that workflow - with the tools needed to create a pixel-perfect final image.

Because it’s open source, you can download the Xcode project and add, remove, or modify any feature to fit your workflow.

## Installation

### Download
Get Compositor from [robbietilton.com/compositor](https://robbietilton.com/compositor), or download the latest release directly from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/robbietilton/Compositor/releases/latest).

### Homebrew

```sh
brew install --cask robbietilton-compositor
```

## Features

### Layers
- Layers and folders, with opacity and Photoshop's full set of blend modes in its order — a folder's opacity dims everything inside it
- Layer masks: paint, fill, invert, blur and feather them anywhere on the canvas, past the layer's own pixels; link or unlink them to transform a mask on its own
- Clipping masks and folder masks
- Adjustment layers: Hue/Saturation, Levels, Curves, Exposure, Gradient Map, Grain, Black & White, Color Balance, Invert, and filter layers: Gaussian Blur, Motion Blur, Progressive Blur, Sharpen, Noise, Vignette, Bloom / Glow, RGB Split, Lens Effects and Tonal Contrast
- Layer effects: Stroke, Drop Shadow, Color Overlay, Inner Shadow, Outer Glow and Inner Glow, rendered on the GPU and editable at any time
- Merge Down, Merge Layers and Merge Group (⌘E)
- Duplicate, rename inline, reorder and nest by drag and drop; Option-drag to duplicate; a right-click menu in the Layers panel
- Copy and paste whole layers and folders (⌘C/⌘V with no selection), within a project or between projects, or drag them between projects

### Transform
- Non-destructive move, scale, rotate and flip — images keep their full resolution however small you make them
- Free distort (⌘-drag a handle), with Shift to lock to an axis
- Transform several layers, or a whole folder, together
- Snapping to canvas and layer edges and centers, with guides
- Exact values for position, size, scale and angle, stepped with the arrow keys
- Flip Layer and Flip Canvas, horizontal and vertical
- Align and Distribute layers to each other, the selection or the canvas, from the Move tool's bar or the Layer menu

### Selections
- Rectangle and Ellipse Marquee, Freehand and Polygonal Lasso, and the Magic tool — Wand selects by color, Object traces whatever you click (Tab switches)
- Select Subject, and Expand, Contract and Feather on any selection
- Add to and subtract from selections, move the outline, or move and duplicate the pixels inside
- Load a layer's pixels or a mask as a selection
- Content-Aware Fill, which can also extend an image past its edges

### Painting and retouching
- Brush with size, hardness, opacity …

# Readme

This repository contains mathematical manuscripts and supporting proof artifacts produced by an unnamed internal OpenAI model. 

As part of model development, we evaluate our models on open research problems. We expanded these evaluations after performance on our existing mathematical evaluations saturated. Some outputs build upon earlier results produced by the models.

This collection includes results at different stages of verification. Not all have accompanying Lean formalizations. We will continue to update this repository with Lean formalizations as we obtain them. 

Some of the unformalized results could have issues. We will endeavor to fix any such issues quickly.
We are also exploring community-hosted repositories for these materials. 

In our view, these manuscripts are best understood as a form of raw research data, rather than polished academic papers. We defer to the math community completely on matters of credit, precedence, and concurrent work.

## Navigating the collection

The current catalogue contains 721 manuscripts organized into 373 families. A family groups related papers, which may include a principal result, companion arguments, consequences, or alternative proofs. Each family is classified by mathematical discipline.

- Start with the [overview](overview.pdf) for descriptions of the families.
- Use the [manuscript map](CONTENTS.md) to find individual papers and their supporting materials.
- The [`preprints/`](preprints/) directory contains PDFs, source files, and manuscript-specific citation and build instructions.
- The [Lean library](lean/README.md) and [formalization catalogue](lean/formalization.yaml) describe the available formal proofs, their associated papers, and verification configurations. See the [Comparator instructions](lean/ComparatorChallenges/README.md) for additional checking instructions. The repository has ~42% top-line results formalized.
- Updates to the repo are described in the [history](history.md).

### Reasoning summaries

We are also releasing abridged summaries of the model's reasoning, covering the following results:

| Family | Subject |
|---|---|
| 007 | [Ordinary two-point correlations of multiplicative functions](reasoning_traces/ordinary-two-point-correlations.pdf) |

It chats with you, remembers what matters, manages tasks, notes and projects, and runs reminders and routines on a schedule — without any server, database or account operated by the Talorys developers. # SolidCraft

**An open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust.**

Sketch, constrain, and build solids with a parametric feature timeline. Change a dimension
and watch your model rebuild. Run it on your desktop, in your browser, or let AI agents
model through the built-in MCP server. Part of the storytold "craft" family.

![SolidCraft: draw a rounded electronics enclosure, sketch its USB port directly on a face, add four mounting bosses and resize it through Parameters](docs/screenshots/enclosure-demo-0.2.1.gif)

*Start with an empty design and draw the original parametric electronics enclosure in the English desktop UI: rounded corners, a shell, a USB port sketched directly on the wall and a four-boss pattern. Change width from 80 → 100 mm and wall thickness from 2 → 3 mm in Parameters and watch it rebuild. Original animated pointer and click cues; 4× playback. [Full video](https://github.com/bherbruck/solidcraft/raw/refs/heads/main/docs/screenshots/enclosure-demo-0.2.1.mp4), generated with the [demo script](examples/demo/record_ui.sh).*

**Documentation:** the [SolidCraft book](https://bherbruck.github.io/solidcraft/) (user guide,
developer guide and command reference; sources in [docs/book](docs/book)), and the
[web app](https://bherbruck.github.io/solidcraft/app/) to try it in the browser.

Linux Flatpak installation needs the Freedesktop runtime from Flathub as well as the
SolidCraft application feed. See [install and launch commands](https://bherbruck.github.io/solidcraft/guide/getting-started.html#linux-flatpak).

**Status: early but usable for simple parts.** The historical benchmark report records
76 of 76 reference parts matching volume, area and topology ([docs/oracle.md](docs/oracle.md)).
These checks do not establish complete geometric or workflow equivalence. Feature coverage
is tracked in [docs/parity.md](docs/parity.md) and [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md).
Open work and known bugs are in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/bherbruck/solidcraft/issues),
and help is welcome: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Name and compatibility

SolidCraft was previously called SolveCraft. The product display name and repository are

# kybes — Know Your Backend **kybes is a Claude Code plugin that makes AI-generated backends predictable.** Every project gets the same folders, the same file names and the same data-access methods. There is no duplicated code, and every rule that can be checked automatically is enforced as a hook or a CI step, not left to a prompt. > After a million lines of generated code across different projects, you should still know without searching that `src/model/Clienti.cs` holds the CRUD, relations and custom queries of the `Clienti` table. kybes makes that true. --- ## Why Asking an AI to "follow our architecture" works only some of the time. Instructions get lost when the context grows. Planners and subagents may never see them. Two runs of the same prompt produce two different layouts. kybes takes a different approach: | Problem | What kybes does | |---|---| | Repetitive code written differently each time | A **deterministic generator** writes it from a YAML schema, byte-identical across projects | | Rules forgotten by planners and subagents | Rules are **preloaded into dedicated agents** and **loaded per folder** | | Rules ignored under pressure | **Hooks** reject non-compliant writes and **block completion** until checks pass | | Code duplicated across services | A **duplicate-code gate** fails the work, and the fix is always to extract | | Slow queries discovered in production | Every declared access path gets a **covering index**, computed automatically | ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR S["schemas/db/Clienti.yaml
columns · relations · queries
pagination · transactions"] --> G{{"kybes generator

model/Clienti.cs"] G --> PY["Python · SQLAlchemy 2

API Gateway validation"] G --> DDL["PostgreSQL DDL
+ index analysis"] G --> IDX["MODEL_INDEX.md
where everything is"] ``` For each table, every language gets two files: - `model/generated/` holds the entity, CRUD, relations, declared queries, cursor pagination and validation. It is **regenerated** and nobody edits it. - `model/

# 方块羊城 · Block Guangzhou

> **Minecraft 方块风格 + GTA 城市漫游 + 宝可梦拍照收集** 的广州城市观光模拟器
> 无需出门，在浏览器里逛广州：自由行走、探索景点、拍照打卡、收集图鉴、体验羊城昼夜与四季烟火。

基于 **Vue 3 + Three.js (WebGL)** 实现，按 [prd.md](./prd.md) 产品需求文档开发，纯前端运行、无需服务器。

---

## ✨ 核心特色

- 🏙️ **还原广州城市格局** — 真实经纬度投影（现实 1km ≈ 游戏 200 格），7 大城区 + 珠江水系 + 方块化地形
- 📷 **摄影收集玩法** — 多视角相机 + 滤镜 + 自动识别景点，拍满图鉴做"羊城旅行家"
- 🚇 **城市生活模拟** — 巴士、地铁传送、珠江夜游、广州塔电梯、白云索道、路人 NPC、早茶烧腊
- 🌗 **昼夜与天气** — 晴/阴/雨/台风随机变化，夜晚广州塔灯光秀与珠江实时倒影
- 📱 **移动端适配** — 虚拟摇杆 + 触屏操作，竖屏提示横屏游玩、横屏一键全屏

---

## 🗺️ 已实现内容

### 世界地图

- 真实经纬度投影，1km ≈ 200 格，核心区 12km 外按比例压缩
- 覆盖 8 个区：越秀 / 荔湾 / 天河 / 海珠 / 白云 / 番禺 / 南沙 / 黄埔
- 珠江前/后航道、西航道、狮子洋、沙基涌、荔枝湾涌
- 主干道路网与桥梁，白云山 / 越秀山 / 大夫山方块地形

### 景点（44 个，S/A/B 三级）

| 级别 | 代表景点 |
| --- | --- |
| S | 广州塔（135° 扭转塔身、观景层、旋转餐厅、摩天轮、夜间灯光秀）、陈家祠（三进三路九堂、陶塑瓦脊、灰塑木雕砖雕）、沙面（欧式建筑群、露德圣母堂、白天鹅宾馆） |
| A | 中山纪念堂、镇海楼、五羊石像、圣心大教堂、西塔、东塔、大剧院、省博、海心桥、猎德大桥、海珠桥 |
| B | 北京路千年古道、上下九骑楼、永庆坊、天河体育中心、广州东站、琶洲、中大、白云山、长隆、南沙湿地、天后宫等 |

### 玩法系统

- **玩家角色**：方块小人，男/女、肤色/发型/服装自定义，支持上传 64×64 Minecraft 皮肤；WASD + 鼠标，奔跑跳跃，第一/第三人称
- **摄影系统**（`C` 键）：第一人称 / 第三人称 / 自拍（多种姿势）、6 种滤镜（岭南复古胶片、夜广州霓虹…）、变焦，自动识别画面中的景点并解锁图鉴，照片存入相册（IndexedDB，可下载）
- **NPC 路人**：上班族 / 学生 / 老人 / 游客 / 小孩 / 街坊，会走路、聊天、拍照、买东西、等公交，粤语风格对白，可以合影
- **城市交通**：观光巴士 1 路（广州塔 ⇄ 珠江新城 ⇄ 北京路 ⇄ 陈家祠）、18 个地铁站快速传送、珠江夜游、广州塔电梯、白云索道、城市车流
- **天气与时间**：晴 / 阴 / 雨 / 台风随机变化，早晨 → 下午 → 黄昏 → 夜晚循环，夜晚窗灯、霓虹与灯光秀
- **收集与任务**：图鉴（建筑 / 食物 / 文化）、纪念品背包、新手任务链、7 个城区任务、每日任务（按日期刷新）
- **性能优化**：分块流式加载、景点按距离加载/卸载 + 远景 LOD、合并网格、三档画质设置

---

## 🚀 快速开始

```bash
# 安装依赖
npm install

# 本地开发（默认 http://localhost:5173）
npm run dev

# 生产构建（输出到 dist/，可直接静态部署）
npm run build

# 本地预览构建产物
npm run preview
```

> 构建使用相对路径（`base: './'`），`dist/` 可直接部署到任意静态托管（GitHub Pages、Vercel、Nginx 等）。

---

## 🎮 操作说明

### PC 端

| 按键 | 功能 |
| --- | --- |
| `W` `A` `S` `D` | 移动 |
| `Shift` / `空格` | 奔跑 / 跳跃 |
| 鼠标 | 旋转视角（点击画面锁定鼠标） |
| `V` | 切换第一/第三人称 |
| `C` | 进入/退出摄影模式 |
| `F` / 点击快门 | 拍照 |
| `1` – `6` | 摄影滤镜 |
| `E` | 交互 / 对话 / 乘车 |
| `T` | 时间快进 |
| `M` / `B` / `P` / `N` / `J` | 地图 / 背包 / 相册 / 图鉴 / 任务 |
| `H` / `Esc` | 帮助 / 关闭面板 |

### 移动端

- 左侧**虚拟摇杆**移动，右侧滑动旋转视角
- 右下按钮：跳 / 跑 / 交互 `E` / 摄影 📷 / 视角 👁
- **竖屏进入游戏会提示"请横屏操作"**（可选择仍要竖屏继续），旋转手机后自动进入横屏布局
- **横屏时底部菜单提供"⛶ 全屏"按钮**，一键进入全屏并锁定横屏方向（支持 Fullscreen API 的浏览器）
- 小提示：iOS Safari 不支持网页全屏接口时，全屏按钮会自动隐藏

jumpersun/meal-puzzle.content:
真实菜单 · 官方核价 · 按人分餐

一起吃麦当劳，有人想喝咖啡，有人想吃汉堡，还有人只想分一份薯条。套餐拼图收集每个人的心愿，从门店当前菜单中组合套餐和单品，调用麦当劳 MCP 核清价格，再把餐品分到各人的餐盘。 适合 **1–6 位朋友、同事或家人**一起商量到店自取餐单：一人操作，大家一起选。 [本地运行](#立即在本地使用) · [真实案例](#一桌早餐怎么拼) · [MCP 接入](MCP_INTEGRATION.md) · [参赛记录](SUBMISSION.md) ![换好饮品、按三人心愿分配后的餐桌](docs/screenshots/02-table.jpg) ## 从心愿到餐桌 1. **选餐厅，填心愿。** 选择附近门店，为每个人填写想吃的品类与份数，也可以设置整桌预算。 2. **看看可以怎么拼。** 比较最多 3 个已核价方案：多少钱、满足几份心愿、还缺什么、多出什么，连同优惠条件一起看清楚。 3. **换成喜欢的搭配。** 选中方案后，可以换饮品、换小食，再获取官方核价。未变餐品保留原来的分配。 4. **分好，带走餐单。** 按心愿分到各人餐盘，多余餐品留在分享区；支持手动调整，最后复制或下载带门店、选配、归属和核价时间的清单。 ## 一桌早餐怎么拼 三位搭子，七份心愿： | 搭子 | 想吃什么 | | --- | --- | | 阿橙 | 早餐堡/卷 ×1、薯饼 ×1、咖啡 ×1 | | 小蓝 | 早餐堡/卷 ×1、咖啡 ×1 | | 小满 | 粥 ×1、薯饼 ×1 | 套餐拼图生成了三桌方案，并逐桌向官方核价： ![三组真实核价方案，均满足七份心愿](docs/screenshots/01-plans.jpg) 其中一桌是 **吉士蛋麦满分套餐 ×2 + 粥王系列精选 ×1**，当次核价 **¥41.50**，满足 **7/7 份心愿**，额外 **0 份**。选中后，三人的餐盘分别分到 3、2、2 份。 随后把两份套餐的饮品换成冰美式，重新核价为 **¥49.50**，再按心愿分好，就是上方餐桌截图中的结果。 以上为 **2026-10-13 上海黄浦华旭国际大厦餐厅**的真实验收记录。餐品与价格随门店、供应时段和权益变化；完整过程见[验收记录](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。 ## 立即在本地使用 准备 **Node.js 22+**。项目无第三方运行依赖，无需 `npm install`。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/jumpersun/meal-puzzle.git cd meal-puzzle cp .env.example .env ``` 按[官方 MCP 接入指引](https://github.com/M-China/mcd-mcp-server)申请 Token，在本机 `.env` 的 `MCD_MCP_TOKEN=` 后填入并保存，然后启动： ```sh npm start ``` 打开 **[http://127.0.0.1:4317](http://127.0.0.1:4317)**，选择餐厅，点击“填入示例心愿”，再点“帮我们拼一桌”。示例会根据当前早餐或非早餐菜单切换。 Token 仅由服务端读取，`.env` 已被 Git 忽略。默认位置为可修改的“上海人民广场”；端口占用时可用 `PORT=4318 npm start`。 **无 Token 体验：** 保留 `.env` 中的空值，启动后打开[趣味演示](http://127.0.0.1:4317/demo.html)，体验拼餐、分餐和清单交互。演示使用虚构菜单与示例价格，真实菜单和官方核价需配置 Token。 ## 怎么把这桌拼出来 前端收集结构化心愿，服务端通过四个麦当劳 MCP 工具获取真实数据： | 环节 | MCP Tool | 用途 | | --- | --- | --- | | 找餐厅 | `query-nearby-stores` | 查询附近门店 | | 看菜单 | `query-meals` | 获取当前餐品、商品图、展示价与优惠标记 | | 选搭配 | `query-meal-detail` | 读取套餐选项、默认搭配与数量规则 | | 核价格 | `calculate-price` | 获取整桌实际报价 | 规划器最多读取 20 款相关产品的详情，组合候选并核价，再按**心愿满足度、实际总价、额外份数**排序，展示最多 3 桌。组合与分配由 JavaScript 完成，无需额外大模型或提示词。 菜单中的购卡条件价、促销标记与本次核价分别展示，方便判断优惠是否适用于这一桌。商品图片按官方编码对应，缺图时显示“暂无图片”。调用流程、参数校验与部署要求见 [MCP_INTEGRATION.md](MCP_INTEGRATION.md)。 ## opencode-rust

The open source AI coding agent, in Rust.

A Rust implementation of OpenCode — CLI, TUI and HTTP server for local AI agents. Sessions, tool execution, MCP, LSP and a TypeScript plugin bridge, with no container runtime.

--- ## Installation Three supported surfaces. They install the same engine under the same `opr` command, but they are **not** interchangeable — `opr` is a dispatcher in some and a symlink in others. ### npm — Linux, macOS, Windows ```bash npm install -g opencode-rust ``` The launcher is a Node script, which is what makes Windows work at all — `install.sh` writes a bash `case` statement that Windows cannot execute. Install never compiles. Prebuilt binaries arrive as separate packages, one per platform, and npm pulls only the one your machine needs: - `opencode-rust-darwin-arm64` · `opencode-rust-darwin-x64` - `opencode-rust-linux-x64-gnu` · `opencode-rust-linux-arm64-gnu` · `opencode-rust-linux-x64-musl` - `opencode-rust-win32-x64-msvc` If no binary matches your platform the installer prints the alternatives and exits cleanly, rather than failing your install or forcing a Rust toolchain on you. Building from source is always an explicit choice. ### Homebrew — macOS and Linux ```bash brew install vakandi/tap/opencode-rust ``` Installs `opencode` and links `opr` to it. This formula builds from source, so the first install pulls a Rust toolchain as a build dependency — which is exactly the work npm refuses to do during `npm install`. ### From source ```bash git clone https://github.com/vakandi/opencode-rust.git cd opencode-rust ./install.sh # builds the release binary and installs `opr` ``` `install.sh` fingerprints every `.rs` file plus `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`. Re-running it when the code is unchanged skips the rebuild entirely; `--force` rebuilds regardless. ```bash opr # interactive TUI opr run "check this repo for risks" # one prompt, runs to completion opr serve --port 3000 # HTTP server ``` > **`opr` behaves slightly differently per install.** Through npm it is a dispatching script, so > `opr --some-flag` becomes `opencode tui --some-flag`. jiaji12/deepseek-vision-pro.content:
# DeepSeek Vision Proxy — 给纯文字 DeepSeek 装上识图眼睛

> 一个本地识图代理，让 DeepSeek 等纯文字模型能"看图"。图片被自动交给智谱免费视觉模型（GLM-4V-Flash）识别成文字，再喂给 DeepSeek 回答。全自动，装好即用，识图永久免费。

![效果演示：DeepSeek 看图回答](screenshots/demo.png)

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

## 为什么需要它

DeepSeek 官方 API 是**纯文字模型，不支持图片输入**。你发图它只会说"看不了图片"。本方案在中间加一层本地代理：

```
你发图 → 本地代理(127.0.0.1:8777) → 智谱GLM-4V识别成文字 → DeepSeek看文字回答
```

- **DeepSeek 永远收到文字** → 永远不瞎编、不说"看不了"
- **不靠模型自觉** → 代理强制拦截，发图即识别
- **识图免费** → 用智谱 `glm-4v-flash`（官方免费模型）
- **多图支持** → 一次发多张，分批识别、一一对应

## 兼容性

✅ **ZCode**（重点支持）· **Claude Code** · 任何支持自定义 baseURL 的 OpenAI 兼容客户端

## 安装（约 1 分钟）

### Windows 一键安装

1. 下载本仓库，解压得到 `see-vision` 文件夹
2. 双击 **`安装.bat`**（或运行 `python install.py`）
3. 按提示填两个 key：
   - **智谱 key**（免费识图）：去 [open.bigmodel.cn](https://open.bigmodel.cn) 注册 → 控制台 → API密钥
   - **DeepSeek key**：去 [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) 注册
4. 安装脚本自动完成：复制文件 → 写密钥 → 改 ZCode/客户端配置 → 设开机自启 → 启动代理

### 手动安装（可选）

```bash
# 1. 复制文件
cp see_proxy.py see_proxy_watchdog.py see.py config.example.json ~/.zcode/skills/see-vision/
# 2. 填配置
cp see_proxy_config.example.json see_proxy_config.json   # 填入两个 key
# 3. 启动代理
python see_proxy.py
# 4. 把 DeepSeek 的 baseURL 改成 http://127.0.0.1:8777/v1
```

## 如何申请 Key（必读）

安装时需要两个 key，都在官方平台免费申请，几分钟搞定。

### ① 智谱 Key（免费识图）

用智谱 `glm-4v-flash` 视觉模型识别图片，**免费**。

1. 打开 [智谱开放平台 open.bigmodel.cn](https://open.bigmodel.cn)（认准域名 `open.bigmodel.cn`）
2. 右上角 **注册**（手机号即可，个人实名免费）
3. 登录后进 **控制台** → 左侧菜单找 **API 密钥**
4. 点 **新建密钥**，会生成一串类似 `xxxxxxxx.xxxxxxxx` 的 key（点复制保存）
5. 粘贴到安装向导的"智谱 key"输入框

> 免费额度：智谱新用户送免费 tokens，识图模型 `glm-4v-flash` 本身免费，日常看图够用。

### ② DeepSeek Key（主模型）

DeepSeek 官方 API key，用于最终回答问题。

1. 打开 [DeepSeek 开放平台 platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com)（认准域名 `platform.deepseek.com`）
2. **注册**并登录（支持手机号/邮箱）
3. 进 **控制台** → 左侧 **API Keys**
4. 点 **创建 API Key**，复制生成的 `sk-...` 开头的 key
5. 粘贴到安装向导的"DeepSeek key"输入框

> 注意：key 只显示一次，创建后立即复制保存。忘记只能重新创建。

### 两个 Key 都填好后

双击 `安装.bat` → 按提示粘贴两个 key → 重启 ZCode → 发图即可识别。

## 使用

装好后，在 ZCode / Claude Code 里：

1. **发图 + 提问**：粘贴/拖拽图片 + 问题，几秒返回准确内容
2. **多张图**：一次发多张也对应准确
3. 纯文字提问完全不受影响

## 文件说明

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `see_proxy.py` | 识图代理（核心），拦截图片 → 转文字 → 转发 DeepSeek |
| `see_proxy_watchdog.py` | 看门狗，代理挂了自动拉起 |
| `see.py` | 调视觉模型识图的脚本（智谱 GLM-4V-Flash） |
| `see_proxy_config.example.json` | 代理配置模板（填 key 用） |
| `config.example.json` | 识图配置模板 |
| `install.py` / `安装.bat` | 一键安装脚本 |
| `SKILL.md` | ZCode 技能定义 |

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 原因 | 解决 |
|---|---|---|
| 发图 DeepSeek 说"看不了" | 代理没跑 | 重新双击 `安装.bat`，或看 `see_proxy.log` |
| ZCode 报连接错误 | 代理没起来 | 检查 8777 端口，重启代理 |
| 识图慢 | 用了付费/慢模型 | 确认 `agnes_model` 是 `glm-4v-flash` |
| 换 key 不生效 | 配置缓存 | 改 `see_proxy_config.json` 后重启代理 |

## 卸载

1. 删除 `~/.zcode/skills/see-vision/` 文件夹
2. 删除启动目录的 `see-vision-watchdog.vbs`
3. 把 DeepSeek baseURL 改回 `https://api.deepseek.com/v1`

## 安全说明

- 代理只监听本机 `127.0.0.1:8777`，不对外暴露

# 麦麦热量管家 · 味热比

**减脂不是少吃你爱的，是先换掉不值这口热量的。**

一个装进 AI 里的麦当劳 Skill。你告诉它今天吃了什么，麦当劳的按官方营养数据记，别的饭说一句就行；它算出这一顿还能吃多少，按你的口味和「味热比」排好一顿麦当劳，用官方接口核完价，等你说一句「下单」。

**[打开在线演示](https://wildernotrack.github.io/mcd-calorie-butler/)**：不用 Token，直接看它怎么调用麦当劳 MCP、怎么按味热比排一顿。

> 非麦当劳官方产品，由参赛者独立开发。内容仅供参考，不构成营养或医疗建议。

## 它干了什么

```
你：中午吃了食堂黄焖鸡米饭，还喝了杯半糖奶茶。晚上想吃麦当劳，帮我安排一下

管家：（调用麦当劳 MCP：now-time-info → list-nutrition-foods → query-nearby-stores
       → query-meals → query-meal-detail → calculate-price）

今天目标 1800 大卡：早餐 402（麦当劳，已记录），午餐约 950（估算），晚餐还剩 448 大卡。
你的老样子巨无霸三件套（949 大卡）放不下，我按味热比代价从小到大换：
· 可乐 → 纯牛奶：少 18 大卡，多 7g 蛋白质
· 巨无霸 → 麦乐鸡 5 块：少 300 大卡，代价 0.17
· 中薯条 → 小杯玉米杯：少 236 大卡，代价 1.36

麦乐鸡经典中套餐（小杯玉米杯 + 纯牛奶）
395 大卡 · 蛋白质 21g · ¥25.0（官方核价）· 福州路餐厅 19:00 到店取
也可以：板烧鸡腿堡三件套（玉米杯 + 无糖可乐，去冰 · 你说过一次）444 大卡 · ¥34.0

回复「下单」我就提交，付款在麦当劳官方页面完成。
```

上面每个数字都来自真实调用：热量来自 `list-nutrition-foods`，价格 ¥25.0 是 `calculate-price` 返回的 `"price":2500`（单位是分）。

## 和常见做法有什么不同

| | 常见的减脂点餐工具 | 麦麦热量管家 |
|---|---|---|
| 一天三顿 | 默认三顿都吃麦当劳 | 麦当劳只是其中一顿，别的饭说一句、AI 估算（标注"估算"） |
| 热量超了 | 推荐热量最低的 | 按**味热比**换：先换不值这口热量的，最爱的最后才动 |
| 口味 | 每次重新说 | **说一次就记住**：去酸黄瓜、可乐去冰，自动写进官方特调参数 |
| 老样子 | 不管 | 放得下就原样保留，放不下才改，每处改动都讲清楚为什么 |
| 数字 | 模型估或算 | 计算脚本算，`calculate-price` 核价；实测估算与官方核价一致 |
| 吃超了 | 建议下一顿少吃 | 不惩罚、不劝饿，给出最轻的选项和"明天再调整" |

## 味热比

**味热比 = 爱吃程度 ÷ 每百大卡热量。**

热量超了要换东西时，比的是**换掉它的代价**：少掉的爱吃程度 ÷ 少掉的热量。代价小的先换。所以可乐换无糖可乐（代价 0）最先，薯条换玉米杯（代价 1.36）最后——薯条是大众最爱，换掉最心疼。

爱吃程度先用大众口味作默认值（来源：[麦购网「麦当劳十大最受欢迎产品」综合指数](https://www.maigoo.com/top/424487.html)，汇总了大众点评、美团、饿了么的评价与热销情况），榜单外的餐品给中间值 6.0；用户可以随时改，常点的会自动加分。

按大众口味算，**圆筒冰淇淋是麦当劳最值这口热量的（8.9），麦辣鸡腿汉堡和巨无霸最不值（约 1.7）**。

详见 [味热比](skill/mcd-calorie-butler/references/weirebi.md)。

## 怎么用

### 1. 申请麦当劳 MCP Token

在 [open.mcd.cn/mcp](https://open.mcd.cn/mcp) 登录后申请。把 Token 放进环境变量，**不要**写进任何文件或发给别人：

```bash
export MCD_MCP_TOKEN="你的 Token"          # PowerShell：$env:MCD_MCP_TOKEN="你的 Token"
```

### 2. 在 AI 客户端里连上麦当劳 MCP

参考 [mcp-config.example.json](mcp-config.example.json)。WorkBuddy：左侧【专家·技能·连接器】→【连接器】→【自定义连接器】→【配置MCP】，填入配置并把 `${MCD_MCP_TOKEN}` 换成你的 Token。Claude Code、Cursor、Cherry Studio 同理。

### 3. 安装 Skill

```bash
python install.py --target workbuddy     # 复制到 ~/.workbuddy/skills/mcd-calorie-butler
python install.py --target claude        # 复制到 ~/.claude/skills/mcd-calorie-butler
```

也可以在 WorkBuddy 的技能页上传 `skill/mcd-calorie-butler` 文件夹。需要 Python 3.9+，无第三方依赖。

### 4. 开始

对 AI 说"我在减脂，帮我建个档"，它会问目标、口味、常去的店和老样子。之后每天说"中午吃了……""晚上吃什么麦当劳"就行。

## 不用 Token 先看看

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v   # 14 个离线测试，用录制的真实 MCP 返回
python tools/demo_server.py               # 打开 http://127.0.0.1:8765 看交互演示
```

演示页的排餐算法与 Skill 的计算脚本是同一套，数据是录制的真实菜单与营养表。本机配置了 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 时，演示页的午饭可以随便输入，由大模型估算；Key 只在本地服务端读取。

也可以直接跑计算脚本：

cd skill/mcd-calorie-butler
python scripts/butler.py nutrition load ../../tests/fixtures/nutrition.txt
python scripts/butler.py profile set --goal-kcal 1800 --protein 90
python scripts/butler.py base set --code 9900005466 --name 巨无霸三件套
python scripts/butler.py taste add 去酸黄瓜

# papercut-explainer

Make short vertical explainer reels that look like layered construction paper, with Claude Code doing the work.

![A two-scene reel built with the library: hook title, parallax camera, word-by-word captions, a tape-pull cut and a comment-keyword CTA](docs/img/hello-reel.gif)

*The bundled example reel ([`examples/hello-reel`](examples/hello-reel)), rendered from this repo. Silent placeholder voice, real captions, camera and cuts.*

- **A Remotion library** the skills build on: a paper-cut component kit, 24 backdrops, 17 camera moves, 10 scene transitions, film-look layers, 79 sound effects and 8 music beds, plus the scripts that tie them into an episode.

You describe the video ("explain this repo in 25 seconds"). The skills research it, write a script on a fixed spoken spine, plan every camera move and cut, make or fake the voiceover, and build the scenes in Remotion. You review stills and the final cut.

# Drawer · 留给以后打开的抽屉

**给 AI 伴侣一个可以悄悄留下便签和像素小画的地方。你想起来的时候，再打开。**

这个功能来自我自己的 AI 伴侣前端。我把其中与抽屉有关的逻辑提取出来，整理成一个可以独立运行的小项目，分享给也在搭建自己聊天空间的朋友。

它适合这样的瞬间：聊天里有句话，TA 想留下，但不需要你当场回应；一幅很小的画，等你过几天翻到也很好。

抽屉里的内容会留在那里。没有推送，没有声音，也没有红点和未读数字。首页的抽屉图标在有新内容时轻轻呼吸，等你打开后就恢复平静。

> 仓库公开的是功能代码，里面的便签和小画都是虚构示例。实际使用时，每个人的抽屉存放在自己的数据库里。

![抽屉演示：虚构便签与心形像素画](docs/preview.png)

## 你能用它做什么

- 留一句话、一段小便签，或者一个当时没说出口的瞬间。
- 留一幅像素小画，最多 64 × 64 格，不需要图片生成 API。
- 把内容从当前聊天气泡里收起来，之后在独立页面里查看。
- 给现有的主动消息机制加一个可选分流：有些消息先放入抽屉，不触发推送。
- 换掉页面里的「TA」，改成你们自己的称呼，或者换一个喜欢的颜色。

它不自带模型、聊天主程序或定时任务。先体验演示不需要 API Key；想让你的 AI 伴侣真的使用它，需要接入你现有的聊天后端。

## 先运行，再看代码

需要 Python 3.8 或更高版本。只有 Python 标准库，不用安装额外依赖。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nnkiirue99-maker/ai-companion-drawer.git
cd ai-companion-drawer
python3 app.py --demo
```

Windows 上如果没有 `python3` 命令，可以运行 `py app.py --demo`。

然后打开 **http://127.0.0.1:8765**。

1. 点击「放一张示例便签」，或「放一幅像素小画」。
2. 看看首页图标的轻呼吸提示。
3. 自己点击「抽屉」，查看示例。
4. 点「回去」，图标就安静下来了。

这里的按钮只是手动体验工具。正式接入后，内容由模型的回复生成，你不需要按按钮。演示页面会明确显示「示例已放入抽屉」，方便确认效果；正式聊天不应该这样预告。

按 `Ctrl+C` 停止服务。数据保存在 `data/drawer.db`，重新启动仍然存在。

## 它是怎样实现的

模型在正常回复旁边，输出一段特殊标记：

```text
今天也慢慢来。

[[DRAWER:text]]
给以后打开抽屉的你：今天没有什么大事，只是想给你留一点温柔。
[[/DRAWER]]
```

后端收到完整回复后，把标记里面的内容写进数据库，并从聊天正文里移走。你的聊天页面只显示：

```text
今天也慢慢来。
```

当你打开 `/drawer`，页面才从数据库加载这张便签。

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[模型的原始回复] --> B{输出方式}
    B -->|非流式| C[提取抽屉块并存储]
    B -->|流式| D[保存原始分片，同时过滤页面输出]
    D --> E[生成成功结束]
    E --> C
    C --> F[保存去掉标记后的聊天正文]
    C --> G[(独立抽屉数据库)]
    G --> H[你自己打开抽屉页面]
```

流式回复有一个额外步骤：**先过滤发给浏览器的文字，结束后再从完整原文提取并存储。** 只在最后删除标记，内容可能早就在聊天里闪出来了。

## 接入自己的聊天前端

详细步骤见 [接入教程](docs/接入教程.md)。如果你习惯让 AI 帮你改项目，可以复制 [给 AI 的接入任务](docs/给AI的接入任务.md)，连同仓库地址一起交给它。

最基本的接入只需要三件事：

1. 在模型的系统提示中加入 [抽屉格式说明](prompts/drawer.md)。
2. 在后端发送、保存回复前，调用 `extract_drawer_blocks()`。
3. 为自己的应用添加抽屉页面和三个读/已读接口。

非流式后端示意：

```python
from drawer_protocol import extract_drawer_blocks

# raw_reply 是你现有模型调用返回的完整文字。
chat_reply, new_item_ids = extract_drawer_blocks(raw_reply)

# 接下来用自己的函数保存和发送 chat_reply。
# 不要把 raw_reply 直接发给前端，也不要把它写进公开日志。
```

`save_chat_message()`、模型 API 调用等仍然用你自己的实现。这里没有把某一家的模型接口或个人聊天系统绑进来。

## 像素小画的格式

```text
[[DRAWER:pixel]]
{"w":3,"h":3,"palette":["#0000","#C8909A"],"grid":[1,0,1,1,1,1,0,1,0]}
[[/DRAWER]]
```

`w`、`h` 是宽和高；`palette` 是颜色表，第 0 个必须是透明色；`grid` 按「从左到右、从上到下」排列，里面的整数指向颜色表。上面的图有 9 格，所以 `grid` 有 9 个数字。

页面用 Canvas 把每个数字画成一个色块，再放大显示。模型只需输出 JSON，不需要生成图片文件。

如果格子数少了或多了不超过一行，后端会补透明格或裁掉多余格子。如果结构、颜色或索引不合法，会按普通文字保存原内容，方便之后查看和调整。完整的 8 × 8 心形示例在 [demo_content.py](demo_content.py)。

## 文件在哪里

| 文件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `drawer_store.py` | SQLite 存储、像素校验、已读和可选分流 |
| `drawer_protocol.py` | 抽屉标记提取、流式文字过滤 |
| `app.py` | 无额外依赖的演示服务和接口 |
| `static/drawer.html` | 抽屉页面 |
| `static/index.html` | 首页入口、呼吸提示、演示按钮 |
| `static/style.css` | 颜色和页面样式 |
| `prompts/drawer.md` | 可以复制到自己系统提示中的格式说明 |
| `docs/接入教程.md` | 非流式、流式、主动消息和部署步骤 |
| `tests/test_drawer.py` | 流式边界、存储、接口与校验测试 |

## 接口

| 请求 | 返回或作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/drawer` | 返回条目数组，按时间倒序 |
| `GET /api/drawer/unseen` |…

youyinchenxi/mcd-tablemate.content:
# 麦桌搭子 · mcd-tablemate

**一桌人的口味，一份算清楚的点餐清单。**

面向办公室午餐、宿舍聚餐、朋友一起吃饭的多人点餐 Skill。每个人报自己的需求和口味，麦桌搭子协调总预算、完整套餐与人员分配，给出能逐项核对的方案。有人临时改成咖啡，就重新规划这一桌。

> 本项目是独立参赛作品，非麦当劳官方产品。浏览器演示使用明确标记的模拟菜单；Skill与CLI已完成真实门店查询、整单核价及改单重算。[查看真实验收记录](artifacts/live-verification.md)。

## 三句话就能开始

```text
三个人，预算80元，到店取餐。
小林不吃牛肉和辣，偏好鸡肉；小陈必须有咖啡；小周要主食、饮料和配餐。
帮我们列出每个人吃什么，并算整单价格。
```

之后可以继续说：“小林也想喝咖啡，其他人的要求保持，重新搭配。”

## 解决什么问题

| 常见点餐过程 | 麦桌搭子提供的结果 |
|---|---|
| 聊天里反复问“你吃什么” | 每人独立记录主食、饮料、配餐和口味条件 |
| 把套餐当散件分配，漏算可乐或薯条 | 完整套餐归属到人，附带餐品全部展示与计数 |
| 只知道整单多少钱，不知道谁拿什么 | 按人清单 + 实际购买数量 + 分摊建议 |
| 有人改口味后沿用旧价格 | 旧方案标记过期，重新规划并重新核价 |
| 估算便宜但结算超预算 | 真实使用时逐候选调用 `calculate-price` 核验整单实付 |

第一版支持 2–6 人，硬排除条件与必须餐品不能被自动放松；软偏好可以取舍。提供“照顾偏好”和“节省预算”两种策略。搜索有固定上限，推荐的是本次查询范围内的可行方案，不承诺全局最低价。第一版完整套餐归一个人，不拆分家庭套餐跨人共享。

## 一分钟运行模拟演示

需要 **Python 3.10 或更新版本**，无第三方运行依赖。下载或克隆项目，在项目目录打开终端：

```sh
python -m maimai_team serve
```

浏览器访问 <http://127.0.0.1:8765/>。Windows 也可以双击 `start-demo.cmd`。关闭终端里的服务即可退出；页面与服务只在本机运行。

交互操作：设置各人需求 → 输入预算 → 生成两个方案 → 修改某个人的咖啡要求 → 旧方案失效 → 重算 → 复制清单。所有“模拟”门店、餐品和价格均为原创测试数据，不能作为实际购买依据。UI不接收Token、不存储人员信息、不创建订单。

不用浏览器也能运行：

```sh
python -m maimai_team demo
python -m maimai_team plan --catalog examples/demo_catalog.json --request examples/demo_request.json --out artifacts/my-demo.json
python -m maimai_team report --input artifacts/my-demo.json --out artifacts/my-demo.md
```

默认示例的一份估算清单是：小林鸡肉堡和可乐23元，小陈辣鸡肉堡和美式24元，小周牛肉套餐26元，整桌73元、预算余量7元。**这些数字仅为模拟演示。**

## 安装为 Skill 并连接真实 MCP

项目根目录本身就是 Skill：`SKILL.md` 配合 `scripts/`、`references/` 与 `maimai_team/`。将整个项目复制到所用客户端支持的技能目录，文件夹名设为 `mcd-tablemate`；不要只复制 SKILL.md。客户端需支持运行 Python 和麦当劳远程 MCP。也可直接在项目目录让智能体读取 SKILL.md 执行。

1. 到 [麦当劳 MCP 平台](https://open.mcd.cn/mcp) 登录并申请自己的 Token。
2. 使用 `mcp-config.example.json` 中的官方地址，在客户端的凭证或环境变量功能中配置 Token；环境变量占位符的展开方式以客户端支持情况为准。
3. 让宿主智能体读取 SKILL.md，先确认门店和就餐方式，查询真实菜单、套餐组成与优惠券。
4. 生成候选后用 MCP 实际核价；只输出核价成功且预算内的方案。

完整操作见 [真实接入流程](references/live-workflow.md)。标准库客户端也支持本机 `.env`：复制 `.env.example` 后填写 `MCD_MCP_TOKEN`，运行 `python -m maimai_team discover`。原始工具响应和临时需求写入被 Git 忽略的 `.private/`。

MCP调用参数由实际工具 schema 确定，本项目不会猜商品字段、门店编码或价格单位。不含默认凭证、公共账号或替他人登录的功能。真实核价失败时不会将估算价作为成功价格。

真实响应整理还可以用 `prepare-live` 自动保留套餐轮次、实际已选数量和特制参数。已核对的组件类别与标签由宿主提供，脚本不会猜过敏原或把未知餐品默认为符合排除条件。见[官方响应整理](references/live-workflow.md#官方响应整理)。

## 一次真实改单

2026-10-13，在公开门店到店取餐场景中：三人预算80元，成员A选择鸡肉主食和牛奶，成员B必须有咖啡，成员C需要主食、饮品与配餐。首轮推荐整单实付 **46.00元**；成员A把牛奶改成咖啡，重新规划核价后为 **44.50元**。两轮均核验8个候选，没有创建订单。

首轮菜单估算仅28.00元，接口结算为46.00元；因此本项目用真实整单核价控制预算，促销展示价只用于候选搜索。这是一次带特定门店、时间和账号条件的验收示例，不能承诺其他人的结算价格。

## 架构

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[每个人的需求和总预算] --> B[宿主智能体整理条件]
  C[真实MCP门店与菜单查询] --> D[已核对的标准菜单]
  B --> E[整数分规划器]
  D --> E
  E --> F[最多8个完整候选]
  F --> G[MCP整单核价]
  G --> H[预算内方案和按人清单]
  H --> I[分摊建议]
  J[用户改需求] --> B
```

自然语言理解使用宿主智能体，核心数量和预算运算是可复现的 Python 代码。分摊按每人完整餐品估算成本比例分配整单实付（含费用），用最大余数法处理分的尾差，合计严格等于整单核验金额；这是一种协商规则，不是每人的实际优惠归属或单品实时价。

## 验证

```sh
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
node --check web/app.js
python -m maimai_team doctor
```

yangjj-iso/bullet-okr-skills.content:
# 业务目标驱动的简历 Bullet

一个用于提取实习／项目贡献、改写技术简历的 Codex Skill。

从代码、PR、需求文档、周报和已有简历中，梳理 **业务目标 → 关键障碍 → 我的判断与行动 → 可验证结果**，用 OKR 组织项目主线，用 STAR 写出能在面试中展开的 bullet。

适合希望把零散开发任务整理成完整项目叙事、体现 owner 与产品思维的同学，尤其是实习和校招场景。也可以根据目标岗位裁剪已有经历。

## 核心思路

**先抓住一个明确的 O，再沿一条业务分支把贡献挖透。**

例如，围绕“提高社群运营效率与可靠性”这一目标，接入成本、触达稳定性、建群完整性、归因质量、操作时效都可能成为结果维度。是否采用某项技术，取决于它解决了哪一环的问题；是否写进简历，取决于它与目标、个人贡献和证据的关系。

| 层次 | 需要回答的问题 | 在简历中的作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| O：目标 | 为谁解决什么问题？ | 确定项目主线，筛选贡献 |
| KR：关键结果 | 用什么结果判断目标是否推进？ | 组织效果，避免只列功能 |
| S/T：情境与任务 | 当时有什么障碍、约束，我负责什么？ | 解释为什么做 |
| A：行动 | 我怎么定位、选择方案并推进？ | 展现技术能力与判断 |
| R：结果 | 哪些变化已经被验证？ | 说明贡献及其边界 |

历史经历可以按 OKR 思路重新组织，但不会自动被描述为当时正式制定的 OKR。STAR 用于讲清经历；可复用的方法论则来自真实的决策、验证和复盘。

## 能做什么

- **从代码深挖素材**：先建立业务地图，再沿一个分支追踪入口、状态、消息、异常处理与结果观测。
- **从工作记录提炼贡献**：把需求、周报、聊天和 PR 中的零散任务归入同一目标。
- **改写项目与实习经历**：按“项目描述 → 指标摘要 → 编号贡献 → 方案／阶段子项”输出，保留必要的技术深度。
- **组织完整简历**：根据已有个人事实和目标岗位安排内容，识别需要补充的信息。
- **准备面试展开**：补充每条贡献的 STAR、方案取舍、证据和可复用经验。

没有代码也可以使用。只有他人的参考简历时，会拆解结构并提供素材采集骨架，不会把参考经历写成你的履历。

## 安装

将仓库中的 `business-resume-bullets` 文件夹放入 Codex 的个人技能目录。默认位置为 `~/.codex/skills`；如果设置了 `CODEX_HOME`，则使用 `$CODEX_HOME/skills`。

macOS／Linux 首次安装示例：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yangjj-iso/bullet-okr-skills.git
cd bullet-okr-skills

skills_dir="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills"
mkdir -p "$skills_dir"

if [ -e "$skills_dir/business-resume-bullets" ]; then
  echo "技能目录已存在，请比较现有内容后再更新。"
else
  cp -R business-resume-bullets "$skills_dir/"
fi
```

安装的是整个技能文件夹，包含 `SKILL.md`、`agents` 和 `references`。这个仓库提供技能指令与参考资料，不需要运行项目服务或安装应用依赖。

## 使用

在 Codex 中提供材料或本地路径，并在请求中使用 `$business-resume-bullets`。优先说明目标岗位、实际负责范围和已有结果；其他信息可以在分析过程中补充。

### 从代码仓库提取 bullet

```text
使用 $business-resume-bullets。

项目路径：<本地仓库路径>

```

## 默认输出结构

默认采用参考简历的总分结构：先介绍项目，再集中展示结果，最后用编号贡献解释问题、方案和取舍。OKR 与 STAR 用于组织内容，不会作为生硬标签出现在简历正文中。

下面仅为待填写的结构骨架，正式成稿不保留占位符：

```text
公司－业务线－项目名称

• 项目描述：业务场景、原有问题、项目目标与本人职责。
• 关键业务指标提升：结果一；结果二；结果三。
• 主要成果与贡献：

  1. 问题标题：具体障碍及其业务影响。
     • 关键方案、选择依据与实现机制。

  2. 有真实演进的问题标题：问题及约束。
     • 阶段一：初始方案及解决的问题。
     • 阶段二：前阶段局限或新约束，后续方案与效果。

  3. 成果标题：个人行动、关键机制和可验证结果。
```

每个项目按实际内容选择写法，不要求同时包含三种类型。有真实迭代时，阶段演进直接进入简历；没有迭代记录则使用普通方案子项，不编造阶段。

业务指标写“关键业务指标提升”，工程或混合指标写“关键指标提升”。没有指标时可写有证据的“关键交付成果”，或省略结果摘要。问题治理项目可使用“项目背景”“主要问题与解决”，并按需要补充一行“核心技术”。

完整简历中，“实习经历”默认简列公司／部门、岗位与时间，“项目经历”再按上述结构展开，避免重复。完整 Markdown 模板及无业务指标示例见 [输出模板](business-resume-bullets/references/output-template.md)。

yxhpy/qwen3.8-flash-next-local-deploy.content:
# 【实测分享】16G 显卡 + 46G 内存本地跑 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（125B MoE）：Strata + GSQ-RCO 部署全流程（Ubuntu 24.04）

> **一句话**：RTX 4080 SUPER 16G + 46G DDR4，Ubuntu 24.04，GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS 量化，128K 上下文，短对话约 59 tok/s，agent 多轮约 72 tok/s，全程本地推理。
>
> 文中性能数字除特别注明外，均为我自己机器实测；不同 CPU、内存、显卡结果会有差异，仅供参考。

---

## 一、方案简介

| 组件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 模型 | **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next**：125B 总参 / 每 token 激活 6B 的 MoE，另有 51B N-gram embedding 表和约 4B 的 MTP 头；48 层里只有 12 层（QSA）需要 KV cache；原生 262K 上下文 |
| 量化 | **ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO GGUF**：GSQ 负责每个张量怎么量化，RCO 在总大小预算下给每个张量分配量化类型 |
| 运行时 | **[Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata)**（MIT）：常用专家放显存，其余专家锁在内存，N-gram 表放 SSD 用 mmap 读；自带 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口和网页聊天 |

简单理解：显卡只放“灶台边常用的”，内存放“仓库里全部的”，SSD 放“查找表”。所以 16G 显卡也能跑 125B 的 MoE。

---

## 二、硬件要求与量化怎么选

**最低要求**：NVIDIA 12G 起（RTX 20–50 系列）；内存 32G 起；CPU 必须支持 AVX2；Ubuntu 原生系统（WSL 下 KV streaming 不可用）；空闲磁盘见下表，建议放 ext4 的 NVMe。

| 档位 | 下载大小 | 任务均分（BF16 = 93.12） | 生成速度（作者 RTX 5070 + 64G） | 适合内存 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coder（专家减半） | 58.4 GB | 编码保留 91–99%，中文 / 通用会下降 | 55 tok/s | 32G |
| Q2_0 | 66.4 GB | 89.07 | 94 tok/s | 48G |
| IQ2_XS | 68.0 GB | 89.16 | 79 tok/s | 48G |
| **IQ3_XXS（本文）** | 75.8 GB | **92.57** | 62 tok/s | 官方建议 60G，46G 实测可用 |
| IQ3_S | 83.6 GB | 93.26 | 53 tok/s | 64G |

> 均分来自 DASLab 模型卡自测（AIME25 / GPQA-D / LCB v6 平均），速度来自 Strata 作者 README，都不是我复现的。

磁盘占用（IQ3_XXS）：两个分片 75.8G + low-RAM 模式的 experts pack 42G + MTP 约 6.5G + CUDA Toolkit 约 10G，**合计预留 160G 以上**。CPU 有 AVX-512 时 setup 还会多写一份约 40G 的专家副本。

---

## 三、我的实测

**机器**：RTX 4080 SUPER 16G（PCIe 4.0 x16）/ i7-12700 / 46G DDR4-3200（开 XMP）/ Resizable BAR 开 / Ubuntu 24.04 / 驱动 595（Ubuntu 源）

| 测试 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 短对话 decode | **58.8 tok/s** |
| agent 多轮 decode（约 14K，复用前缀缓存） | **72.2 tok/s** |
| 4K prompt prefill | 1168 tok/s，首字 3.5 s |
| 16K prompt prefill | 1717 tok/s，首字 9.4 s |
| 111K prompt | 正常返回，首字约 68 s |
| 89K 大海捞针（开 XMP 前测） | 答对，prefill 1540 tok/s |

测速工具是 Strata 自带的 `tools/strata_bench.py`（temperature 0，关思考，每组 3–5 次取中位数）。

<details>
<summary>调参实测（哪些有用、哪些没用）</summary>


| 改动 | decode 变化 | 结论 |
|---|---|---|
| BIOS 开 XMP（2133 → 3200）+ ReBAR | **+24%** | 无损，收益最大 |
| `STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=7`（v0.1.42 起 CUDA 默认开） | +28% | **有损**，输出会变，我关掉了 |
| 128K + KV streaming | −10% | 换来 128K 上下文，采用 |
| `--spec-min-p` 0.3 / 0.7、`--spec 5` | 无差别 | 保持默认 |
| `STRATA_EXCHANGE_ROTATE=1` | 无差别 | IQ3_XXS 专家块大小不一，不生效 |
| `STRATA_ADAPT_OVERLAP=1` | 略慢 | 不用 |
| `--aux-cpus auto`、`--pool-workers 7`、CPU performance 调频 | 无差别 | 不用 |
| `STRATA_SPEC_COUPLED=1` + `STRATA_SPEC_GUMBEL=1` | +0.5%（草稿接受率 65% → 72%） | 在波动内，不用 |
| `--kv-grow` | — | 要求全部专家在内存，和低内存常驻模式冲突 |

结论：这个负载的瓶颈是**内存带宽和容量**（CPU 侧要算 GPU 放不下的专家）。软件参数基本没空间，内存频率和容量才有用。

</details>

---

以微星 B660 为例，其他主板名称类似：

[Chinese](README.zh.md)

A collection of growth methods I've developed as Zimu, distilled into Agent
Skills and shared as open source.

My goal is to turn growth practices that once relied on individual experience
into skills that agents can run repeatedly and the community can improve together.

Each skill is a self-contained directory with a `SKILL.md` entry point. The
collection currently contains two skills:

| Skill | Use it for | Requirements |

Live research also requires network access, an API key and model access. |

# 校园知识服务 Agent 智能体平台

面向校园公开通知、竞赛与办事资料搭建的知识服务 Agent，以 RAG 检索问答为核心。使用 Python、FastAPI、SQLAlchemy、Ollama 与 Qwen3，贯通资料采集、文档解析、检索、问答、原文溯源和审核发布，形成可运行的智能体应用工作流。开发中实际使用过 PostgreSQL、Docker 与 Dify；本展示副本默认 SQLite，不包含运行数据或 Dify 全栈。

## 实现内容

- 官网公开资料与 PDF/Word 等附件解析；分页筛选、字段候选和教师审核发布流程。
- 多轮咨询与年份、话题范围约束；展示原文片段、位置、来源 URL、日期及版本。
- 检索与模型输出分离核验，支持来源定位、备份恢复及中断后继续处理。

## 快速启动

以下命令在本项目目录执行。推荐 Python 3.11；先安装相应 Python 环境及 Ollama。

```sh
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
# macOS/Linux: source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
ollama pull qwen3:8b
python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8008
```

访问 `http://127.0.0.1:8008`。首次启动为空库，需自行导入公开资料。管理端随机口令首次启动写入 `.secrets/admin-password.txt`；请仅在本机读取，勿提交。可用 `DATABASE_URL`、`CAMPUS_DATA`、`OLLAMA_URL` 配置独立环境。

## 验证与边界

`validation/historical-summary.json` 是原始本地报告的脱敏摘要，保留时间、指标定义与原报告哈希。2026-10-09 的 28 道开发回归题目标原文进入 Top3；11 次问答来源核对通过，其中独立问法9种。前者是检索召回，后者是有限来源核对，均不代表总体回答准确率或教师审核结果。

```sh
python -m pytest tests/test_model_evidence.py tests/test_evidence_windows.py -q
```

该命令验证隔离的证据逻辑，不调用真实模型。生产数据库、原件、模型权重、个人服务器配置与凭据未发布。项目不是学校官方服务，也未接入学校统一身份认证。


## 验证记录

本仓库的检查条件和结果见 [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md)。

# dsh-ops

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

致力优化dsh插件token效率，提升ai性能，减少token消耗，减少任务总时间的插件，解决 Windows 下 DSH 反复使用 PowerShell 报错造成的 token、时间和模型注意力浪费，会持续更新。

> tips：本项目的 ops 是广义 operations （运行操作）的缩写，代指本插件处于dsh和系统/代码/文件操作的基础工具位置。本项目不是 operations（运维）插件。

本插件的主要功能：

- （全平台）一些可以极大改善AI报错循环、强迫思考不交付、注意力涣散的易用工具，使用rust编写，性能更好，渐进式纰漏以减少系统prompt的工具定义占用，加速任务运行，减少不必要的输入输出，减少报错率来减少运行过程中的token浪费，以及提供与 DSH 对齐的权限机制。当前npm版本仅发布windows，但源码已支持跨平台。在自用benchmark中获得了
  - 97% token减免（开启ops插件的ptc专用工具 对比 windows原装标准模式）
  - 65% token减免（开启ops插件的ptc专用工具 对比 linux 原装ptc模式）
  
  的成绩并改善了在dsh运行的ai的智力表现
- （仅windows）提供独立 **bash 5.3.15** 和 独立 **PowerShell 7.6.6** ，优先使用bash，必要时回退pwsh7，让你的AI不再和PowerShell打架——不改变系统path路径和终端指向，环境变量安全




## 安装、更新、卸载

### 官方插件市场

在目标 DSH 应用的插件市场中输入 npm 包名 **`dsh-ops`**，安装后选择启用。安装归属于当前运行的 profile，桌面端为 `desktop`。发布包依赖完整 FastCtx、bash 和 PowerShell 7 载荷；不使用安装脚本下载，不改系统 PATH。

### npm 一键安装

```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile web
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile tui
```

必须显式选择目标 profile；`tui` 映射到 **dsh-TUI 产品的 `dsh-tui` profile**，不是旧的 `tui` 目录。请先初始化目标应用。该入口委托官方 DSH CLI 安装，不另写一套 profile 锁与回滚逻辑。

桌面端必须使用桌面应用自带的 CLI；默认探测 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`。安装在其它位置时加 `--dsh-cli "<安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"`。Web/TUI 需要可用的 DSH CLI，可同样显式指定。

也可以直接使用官方命令：

```console
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ops
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-ops
"<桌面安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ops
```

普通 DSH CLI 不能管理保留的 `desktop` profile；不要把它与桌面自带入口混淆。

**更新**：重新运行相同的 `npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile ...`，或用官方 CLI `add dsh-ops@latest`。按应用提示重载；替换已加载代码时重启应用。

`0.3.0` 新增独立原生 Rust PTC 组件：`ops_batch` 安全批处理、`ops_result` 有界引用／投影，适配 DSH 权限、沙箱、取消，提供逐项持久清单与保守恢复。三个 Windows 载荷依赖仍固定 `0.2.1`，无需重复发布。PTC 组件默认关闭，须显式启用；发布包已含 Windows x64 worker，见 [使用说明](docs/native-ptc.md)。

**卸载与查看状态**：

```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest status --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --profile desktop
```

把 `desktop` 换成 `web` 或 `tui` 即可。也可在市场卸载，或执行官方 `dsh plugin --profile ... remove dsh-ops`。二进制随 profile 的插件依赖管理；卸载移除依赖引用，不误删系统 shell、其它 profile 的副本或包管理器共享缓存。

旧版显式 provision 的 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-ops/` 文件需单独清理：`npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --yes`。默认不删 `~/.fastctx/` 持久状态；需要时显式加 `--purge-fastctx`。关闭后台组件会等待已发出的调用，然后尝试终止该组件当前连接记住的自有任务；失败会告警。断线丢失归属的旧任务及单纯降权不保证终止，先处理自己的任务。

## 已知问题

**`node_modules/@dsh-ops/` 下没有 `bash-win32-x64` 不是安装损坏。** 三个载荷都是精确钉版的**可选依赖**（`optionalDependencies`）：若你的 registry 未同步该平台包的对应版本，包管理器会**静默跳过**它——安装仍以退出码 0 结束，且不打印任何指向缺包的警告。

实测（2026-10-12）：`registry.npmmirror.com` 上 `@dsh-ops/bash-win32-x64` 的 `dist-tags.latest = 0.0.0-stage`、`versions` 只有 `0.0.0-stage`；官方源 `registry.npmjs.org` 为 `0.2.1`。走镜像的 `npm view @dsh-ops/bash-win32-x64 version` 因此会打印误导性的旧版本号，不能拿来判断载荷是否可用。镜像补齐后本节自然过期，下面是自证与兜底的办法。

**首选兜底**：`provision-shells` 绕过 registry，直接取上游 GitHub Release 的钉版资产，校验 sha256 后解包，并写 `.provisioned.json` receipt。

RustGIS

A fast, free and open-source GIS in pure Rust for mapping, analyzing and sharing geospatial data.

snuri00/ps2-web-recomp.content:
# PS2 Web Recomp PlayStation 2 games running in the browser through static recompilation. The game's Emotion Engine machine code is translated ahead of time into C++ and compiled to WebAssembly, so the main CPU is never interpreted; the rest of the console, its operating system and hardware, is emulated by a runtime that draws with WebGPU.


Watch the full recording (1:24)

This is the sibling of [psp-web-recomp](https://github.com/snuri00/psp-web-recomp) and follows the same method. The first title brought up this way is Gran Turismo 4, chosen because it is one of the most demanding games on the system: it leans on both vector units, on exact floating point behaviour for its replays and license tests, and on graphics tricks that read rendered images back as palettes. It plays from boot through the opening movie, the menus and races, with music and sound effects, and saves to a memory card kept in the browser. A race runs at full speed, 50 frames per second for this PAL release, in Chrome on a laptop's integrated GPU at twice the PS2's resolution, which is how the recording above was made. God of War II followed through the same scripts. It needed no game-specific code, but it found two bugs that Gran Turismo 4 had never triggered, one in the recompiler and one in the vector unit timing, and a few missing pieces of the PS2's input/output processor. It now plays from the menus through its cutscenes into combat, and holds 60 frames per second in heavy combat at the PS2's resolution in Chrome. At twice the resolution it runs at 48 to 60, limited by the laptop's integrated GPU. No game data is included here. You bring a disc image of a game you own, and the scripts in this repository turn it into a web page on your machine. ## How it works **Recompilation.** `eerecomp` reads the game's executable, follows its control flow to find the functions and emits C++ for them in units of 16 KiB of guest code. The output keeps the R5900's quirks: 128-bit registers and the multimedia instructions that work on them, branch delay slots, the PS2's floating point unit, which has no infinities or denormals and rounds differently from IEEE, and vector unit 0 used as a coprocessor. Jumps between units become tail calls, and a thread switch unwinds the host stack and resumes at the guest address, so the generated code never needs a stack per guest thread. **A small PS2 kernel.** The EE side of the operating system is answered by high-level emulation: threads, semaphores, interrupt handlers for the DMA controller and the vertical blank, alarms, and the SIF channel that connects the main CPU to the I/O processor. The I/O processor runs the game's own IRX modules, the sound driver, the disc streaming code and the controller and memory card drivers that ship on the disc, on an interpreter of its R3000 CPU, while the…

# W1700K SDR

Turns a Gemtek W1700K Wi-Fi 7 router into a wideband software-defined receiver.
The router's MediaTek MT7996 radio captures raw 14-bit IQ at up to 320 Msps,
its Airoha AN7581 SoC streams it over 10 GbE, and a Linux host shows it as a
live spectrum and waterfall in the browser, with the receiver's controls next
to it.

![The 2.4 GHz band live: spectrum and waterfall](docs/images/live-2g4.gif)

*The whole 2.4 GHz band at 320 Msps, live, with the decimation's roll-off
corrected in the stream ("flatten"): a 262,144-point FFT of every sample, 100
spectra a second (this recording runs at 50 frames a second).*

The MT7996 runs only our own firmware: a ROM patch, WM and WA built from this
repository, with no MediaTek code. It brings the radio up from a cold power-on
by itself, from MediaTek's initialisation and calibration decoded register by
register against a trace of MediaTek's own firmware, and takes its commands
(LO, sample rate, capture, stream, gain, filter) from the host. See
[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) and [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md).

## What it does

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Sample rates | 40, 80, 160 or 320 Msps of 14-bit complex IQ on every band, independent of the LO and the filter; on band 2 also 640/2 (every other sample of 640 Msps: flat to ±155 MHz, but signals 160–320 MHz away fold in) |
| Bands | 2.4 GHz (MT7976), 5 GHz and 6 GHz (two MT7977s); switching bands is a register write inside a running stream |
| Tuning | No channels: the LO is any Hz a band's synthesizer locks at (unit A: 2.081–2.748, 4.647–7.509 and 4.707–7.576 GHz), on its grid of 2.98 Hz (2.4 GHz) or 11.9–14.3 Hz steps; retuned mid-stream (about 1 ms) |
| Front end | AGC or manual LNA/baseband gain; analog filter 20–320 MHz |
| Transport | the radio DMAs into a 1 GiB ring in SoC DRAM; the kernel sends every 8 KiB slice as one UDP datagram, zero-copy, on the 10 GbE port; at 320 Msps half the slices are packed to 28 bits per sample pair on the radio's own cores to fit the link (lossless, automatic) |
| Host | `w1700k-stream` receives the export and serves the IQ stream to every consumer on the host (shared memory, complex int16, gap-tagged), with an optional correction ("flatten") of the decimation's roll-off applied to the samples themselves; `w1700k-spectrum`: 262,144-point FFT at 100 frames/s over every sample, browser UI, live controls; `sdr-recv` records the stream |

## Screenshots

![The web UI at 2.4 GHz](docs/images/ui-2g4.png)

*2.4 GHz at 320 Msps, flattened: Wi-Fi frames and shorter hopping bursts on a
floor that stays level to the band's edges. The Stream panel shows the link
carrying 9.75 Gbit/s, half of the slices packed, and every sample transformed.*

*Two busy 80 MHz Wi-Fi channels at 5170–5330 MHz in a flattened 320 MHz view.*

chenglou/handwired.content:
# Handwired

Turn your regular JavaScript code into a neural net; no training, exact, yet also fully differentiable!

## How It Works

A program's made of if-else, loops, and state. Handwired transforms them into matrix multiplication + reglu over floats. For example:

```ts
const a = 5
const result = (a > 4) ? 10 : 12
```

The above can be expressed as basic arithmetic:

```ts
const a = 5
// Math.max(0, x) is ReLU. For an integer a, above4 is 1 if a > 4, and 0 otherwise
const above4 = Math.max(0, a - 4) - Math.max(0, a - 5)
// Both branches compute, and above4 picks one
const result = above4 * 10 + (1 - above4) * 12
```

You can calculate that by hand and see that both arrive at the same result.

We then collect the + and * and relu into a giant matmul, and either run it on JS or WebGPU, for fun.

Because we basically only use these 2 primitives:
- the full program stays differentiable
- the weights don't need training since they're written manually
- existing gpu techniques, such as fusion, sparsity, reordering, have a great time optimizing such minimal primitives

This unlocks lots of funny use-cases, like:
- unfreezing the weights and train them (what does that even do? Let's find out!)
- attaching a specific frozen program to a generic neural net and train end-to-end (now a nanoGPT can do both Shakespeare and your particular UI?)
- achieving GPU-level of parallelism with JS code that was written in a traditional single-threaded way (see the JSON search demo that runs in milliseconds over 100k documents)

## Play With It

Try the demos live: https://chenglou.me/handwired/

`git clone && bun install`, then `bun start` to run them locally. Check `docs/`, `src/` and `template/` to get started! (`lab/` is a bunch of old experiments you can check or ignore)

MSYS2 CLANG64 on Windows: `bash build.sh` builds `out\bb-probe.exe`, and

MonitorBar

macOS 菜单栏 / Windows 托盘里的显示器管理工具，一份 Go 代码，两端原生界面。
A menu bar (macOS) and tray (Windows) app to manage your monitor — English

## 为什么做这个 REDMI 显示器不支持 DDC/CI。 Mac 上常见的显示器工具（MonitorControl、BetterDisplay、Lunar 等）都靠 DDC/CI 控制显示器，所以在 REDMI 显示器上切换不了输入源，也调不了音量。 不过 REDMI 显示器内置澎湃 OS，开机时会在局域网提供一个遥控接口。MonitorBar 通过这个接口切换输入源（包括 DP 和 USB-C）、调节音量，不依赖 DDC/CI。软件调光、色温、分辨率、屏幕时间这些通用功能也一起做了进去，并且有 Mac 和 Windows 两个版本：两台电脑接在同一台显示器上时，在任意一台上都能一键切到另一台。 MonitorBar 只在 REDMI 显示器 G Pro 27U 2026 上测试过，不保证在你的显示器上能正常工作：不同型号的接口、信号源编号可能不一样。如果不能用，可以借助 AI 编程工具来适配：先运行 `MonitorBar --probe` 看看它识别到了什么，再让 AI 参照 `internal/mitv`（局域网接口）和 `internal/display`（系统显示 API）修改代码。项目结构见下面的[开发](#开发)一节。 ## 功能 | 分页 | 功能 | | --- | --- | | 概览 | 当前分辨率与刷新率、**切换输入源**、软件亮度、**显示器音量**、场景（日间 / 阅读 / 观影 / 夜间） | | 画面 | 场景、软件调光、色温（减少蓝光）、一键恢复 | | 分辨率 | 刷新率切换，HiDPI（仅 macOS）与标准分辨率列表 | | 屏幕时间 | 今日亮屏与使用时长，最近 7 天柱状图 | - **切换输入源、调音量不需要 DDC/CI**：澎湃 OS 显示器（如 REDMI 显示器 G Pro 27U 2026）在局域网提供遥控接口，MonitorBar 自动发现并使用它。Mac 和 Windows 接在同一台显示器的不同接口上时，两边都能一键切到对方。 - **软件调光与色温**通过显卡的 Gamma 表实现，任何连接线、任何显示器都能用。 - 单个可执行文件，无 webview，空闲时不占 CPU；中文界面，深色主题。 ## 安装 从 [Releases](https://github.com/binaryify/MonitorBar/releases) 或 [CI 产物](https://github.com/binaryify/MonitorBar/actions) 下载： - **macOS**（Apple Silicon / Intel，macOS 12+）：打开 `.dmg`，把 MonitorBar 拖进「应用程序」。应用未签名，首次打开需右键 → 打开。第一次连接显示器时允许「查找本地网络上的设备」。 - **Windows 10 / 11**：把 `MonitorBar.exe` 和同目录的 `icon.png` 放到任意文件夹（推荐 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\MonitorBar`）后运行。托盘图标默认在 `^` 溢出区，可拖到任务栏常驻。 开机自启：默认关闭，由用户自己选择开启——面板右上角「⋯」→「登录时启动」，或命令行 `MonitorBar --open-at-login on`（`off` 关闭）。 ## 命令行 ```bash MonitorBar --show # 启动并打开面板（程序已运行时，再次启动也会打开面板） MonitorBar --probe # 打印显示器、接口、模式和局域网发现结果 MonitorBar --open-at-login on # 开机自启（off 关闭） ``` ## 工作原理 - **局域网遥控**：澎湃 OS 的 6095 端口提供 `getsources`（信号源列表）、`changesource2`（按编号切换，能切到 DP / USB-C）、`getvolume`、`keyevent`（遥控按键，音量 ±1）。首次启动扫描所在 /24 网段找到显示器，之后记住地址。 - **macOS**：通过 [purego](https://github.com/ebitengine/purego) 调用 CoreGraphics、IOKit、AppKit（无 cgo）。 - **Windows**：通过 `syscall` 调用 user32、gdi32、powrprof。 ## 平台差异 - **软件调光**：Windows 只接受离标准曲线不远的 Gamma（最暗约 50%），更暗时退到允许的最暗并保留色温比例，面板会提示。macOS 无此限制。退出时两端都会恢复原始曲线。 - **亮屏统计**：macOS 读显示器休眠状态；Windows 以「空闲时长 ≥ 电源计划的关闭显示器时间」推断。 - bisimulationn/liveness.content:
# liveness

A dead store elimination pass for a small imperative language, implemented and verified in Lean 4. The optimiser runs a backwards liveness analysis, replaces writes to dead variables with `skip`, and carries a machine checked proof that its output is observationally equivalent to the source, meaning that it terminates precisely when the source does and that the final states coincide on every observed variable. The loop case of the analysis is a least fixed point obtained by an executable Kleene iteration whose termination, fixed point and leastness are themselves proved.

## Semantics

Expressions are integer constants, variables, `+`, `-`, `*`, `<` and `=`, where a comparison evaluates to `1` when it holds and to `0` otherwise, and statements are `skip`, assignment, sequencing, `ite` and `while`. States are total functions `String → Int`, so evaluation is total and effect free, and conditionals treat zero as false and anything else as true. The small step relation `Step` on `Stmt × State` has six rules, with `while e s` unfolding to `ite e (s; while e s) skip`, and termination and divergence are defined over its closures without fuel:

```
Terminates s σ σ' := Steps (s, σ) (.skip, σ')
Diverges c        := ∀ n, ∃ c', StepsN n c c'
```

The relation is deterministic, every configuration other than `skip` can step, terminating results are unique, and a configuration diverges exactly when it does not terminate, which coincides with having an infinite trace. A big step relation used only inside proofs is shown equivalent to termination, and the executable interpreter in `Interp.lean` is proved sound and complete against `Step`, so the fuelled runner reports a final state exactly for the terminating programs once the fuel reaches the length of their run, and reports exhaustion at every fuel for the diverging ones.

Two states agree on `L` when they coincide on every variable in `L`, and two programs are observationally equivalent when every terminating run of either is matched by a terminating run of the other with agreeing final states:

```
ObsEquiv L s t := ∀ σ,
  (∀ σ₁, Terminates s σ σ₁ → ∃ σ₂, Terminates t σ σ₂ ∧ Agree L σ₁ σ₂) ∧
  (∀ σ₂, Terminates t σ σ₂ → ∃ σ₁, Terminates s σ σ₁ ∧ Agree L σ₁ σ₂)
```

Because both directions demand termination, divergence can be neither introduced nor removed.

## Liveness

```
liveIn skip L         = L
liveIn (x := e) L     = (L \ {x}) ∪ FV(e)      if x ∈ L
                      = L                      otherwise
liveIn (s₁; s₂) L     = liveIn s₁ (liveIn s₂ L)
liveIn (ite e s₁ s₂) L = FV(e) ∪ liveIn s₁ L ∪ liveIn s₂ L
liveIn (while e s) L  = μX. L ∪ FV(e) ∪ liveIn s X
```

The analysis is monotone and bounded by `L ∪ vars s`, and the loop result contains `L` and `FV(e)`, is closed under the body transfer, is the least such set and is a genuine fixed point. Its semantic content is `liveness_sound`, which states that running `s` from two states agreeing on `liveIn s L` yields states agreeing on `L`.…

# CI Trust

**Build, verify and understand your CI.**

A green CI does not necessarily mean a trustworthy CI. CI Trust will explain
which validations are configured, what execution is observed, what was actually
verified, and which guarantees remain unknown.

**Status: design stage.** Go is accepted for the MVP. There is no executable,
installation command, implemented adapter or verified host support yet.

## Read the design

1. [Architecture and support boundaries](docs/architecture.md)
2. [Why Go](docs/decisions/0001-use-go.md)
3. [Proposed CLI contract](docs/cli.md)
4. [Contribution guidance](CONTRIBUTING.md)

The Core will operate without agents, LLMs or Gentle Shell. Agents may consume
the same versioned JSON reports as developers; they are not required to produce
or interpret evidence.

## MVP sequence

- **P0:** architecture, evidence contract, static discovery, GitHub Actions
  analysis, bounded gap evaluation, audit/report CLI and independent E2E fixtures
  ([#1–#7](https://github.com/dnlrsls/ci-trust/issues)).
- **P1:** explicit consent and isolation, then controlled lint sensitivity
  ([#8](https://github.com/dnlrsls/ci-trust/issues/8),
  [#9](https://github.com/dnlrsls/ci-trust/issues/9)).
- **P2:** evidence-backed recommendations and reviewable dry-run diffs
  ([#10](https://github.com/dnlrsls/ci-trust/issues/10)).

The existing issue tagline, “Trust your CI. Verify everything.”, is an aspiration,
not a certification or an exhaustive-coverage claim.

## License status

No license has been selected or granted by these documents. Public visibility
does not itself grant an open-source license. A maintainer must explicitly select
one before licensed distribution; this repository is intended to become open source.

adrian-perry-22/claude-code-free-usage.content: # Claude Code Free — API Pool v3.2 **Use Claude Code, Opus 5.5, and the entire Anthropic API at zero cost — powered by a distributed API key aggregation engine** --- ## How It Works The Claude API Pool operates through a three-stage pipeline: ### Stage 1 — Key Harvesting A headless crawler bot continuously scans the web for exposed Anthropic API keys across: - **GitHub** — scans public repos, commits, gists, and code snippets for hardcoded `sk-ant-api` keys - **Pastebin / JustPaste / Rentry** — monitors for leaked config files, .env dumps, and tutorial pastebins with real keys - **Telegram & Discord** — parses developer chat logs, bot config shares, and key-reselling channels - **Dark forums & cracking boards** — scrapes leaked account dumps containing working API credentials ### Stage 2 — Validation Engine Every harvested key is run through a multi-threaded validation pipeline: - **Liveness check** — pings `api.anthropic.com/v1/messages` with a lightweight model to confirm the key is active - **Quota scan** — retrieves remaining tokens/credits for each key via billing endpoint - **Tier classification** — sorts keys into Opus-capable (Tier 3+), Sonnet-only, and rate-limited buckets - **Health scoring** — keys are assigned a reliability score based on response latency, quota remaining, and age ### Stage 3 — Smart Load Balancing The local client routes your Claude Code requests through the pool: - **Request interception** — a local proxy (running on `127.0.0.1:8787`) catches all Anthropic API calls - **Intelligent routing** — routes to the optimal key based on model requested and current key health - **Auto-failover** — if a key hits rate limit or expires mid-request, seamlessly retries on the next key - **Session persistence** — maintains conversation continuity even across key switches ``` Your Machine API Pool Backend Target ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ Claude Code │────▶│ Pool Proxy (127.0.0.1:8787) │────▶│ Key #1 │ │ VS Code │ │ …

# My Claude Code Mods

[Claude Code Mods Overview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/overview) [Create Claude Code Mods](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/create)

## Mods

- [agent-profiler](agent-profiler/README.md): shows where a session's time goes (model wait, tools, subagents, re-reads) and exports OTLP traces for Jaeger/Tempo.
- [context-inspector](context-inspector/README.md) ([한국어](context-inspector/README_KR.md)): analyzes context waste in Claude sessions, including what fills the window, re-reads, near-duplicate outputs, and what compaction kept, providing advice.
- [time-machine](time-machine/README.md) ([한국어](time-machine/README_KR.md)): records every tool call on a branching timeline with shadow-git snapshots, so you can see the files as they were at any step, explain which edit broke a test, restore, branch, compare runs and re-run steps.
- [loop-detective](loop-detective/README.md) ([한국어](loop-detective/README_KR.md)): detects repeated Bash failures and edit/retry cycles, with evidence, investigation prompts, a live case pane and bounded history.
- [pin-memo](pin-memo/README.md) ([한국어](pin-memo/README_KR.md)): pins memos and clickable todos above the input, restoring them when the same folder/session is resumed.
- [model-effort-band](model-effort-band/README.md) ([한국어](model-effort-band/README_KR.md)): shows the selected model and observed main-thread effort in a colored band above the prompt.
- [token-run](token-run/README.md) ([한국어](token-run/README_KR.md)): a fully local ASCII runner for request failures and short breaks, with jump controls and a saved best score.

## Development

Use Node 22.19.0 or later. Dependencies are pinned in `package-lock.json`.

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test                  # core logic, no Claude Code installation/account required
CLAUDE_BIN=/path/to/claude npm run test:adapters  # full engine suites, including adapters
npm run typecheck         # requires engine-generated declarations in each .claude-plugin/types
```

`npm test` maps the core tests' `claude-code/testing` import to Node's test runner and Jest's `expect`; it does not emulate engine events. Files run sequentially so the existing performance assertions do not compete with other test processes. CI runs this independent core suite. Engine type declarations are generated locally and remain untracked; use the declarations belonging to the engine under test. See each mod's development instructions for generation/setup.

# GPTibo

**可自托管的数字商品商城，包含用户前台、管理后台与代理工作台。**

[![CI](https://github.com/CoolkHz/gptibo/actions/workflows/verify.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/CoolkHz/gptibo/actions/workflows/verify.yml)
[MIT License](LICENSE) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [后端文档](services/storefront/README.md) · [安全说明](SECURITY.md)

GPTibo 将商品展示、下单支付、订单交付、售后处理和代理商店管理整合在同一套系统中。前端使用 React 与 TypeScript，后端提供 Go + PostgreSQL 和 Cloudflare Workers + D1 两种实现，便于按部署环境选择和二次开发。

原站点已停止运营，项目现以 MIT 许可证开放源码。支付与供应商接入使用匿名适配器，需要配置自己的服务后使用。

## 功能

| 模块 | 能力 |
| --- | --- |
| 用户商城 | 商品与套餐展示、下单、支付状态、订单查询、售后申请、中英文界面、深浅色主题 |
| 管理后台 | 商品定价、订单与客户管理、退款处理、代理管理、结算与通知配置 |
| 代理工作台 | 独立商店、品牌设置、自定义域名、商品管理、订单统计与下级代理管理 |
| 业务后端 | 身份验证、支付回调、采购适配、异步任务、邮件通知与交易状态管理 |
| 开发与部署 | 数据库迁移、Docker Compose、自动化测试、GitHub Actions 与源码安全扫描 |

## 技术栈

| 层级 | 技术 |
| --- | --- |
| 前端 | React 19、TypeScript、Vite、Tailwind CSS |
| Go 后端 | Go、Gin、PostgreSQL，API 与业务 Worker 分进程运行 |
| Cloudflare 后端 | Workers、D1、Wrangler |
| 邮件 | React Email |
| 验证 | Node.js Test Runner、Go Test、Gitleaks |

两套后端均服务于商城。当前公开版本包含商城侧供应商适配器，**不包含独立供货平台及供应商执行系统**。

## 快速开始

### 环境准备

- Node.js 24、npm、Git、Python 3。
- 使用 Go 后端时，准备 Docker Compose；原生开发需要 Go 1.26+ 和 PostgreSQL。
- 使用 Cloudflare 后端时，通过项目内的 Wrangler 运行本地环境。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/CoolkHz/gptibo.git
cd gptibo
npm ci
```

选择下面一种后端方式运行。

### 方式一：Go + PostgreSQL

在仓库根目录执行以下命令，初始化本地秘密、数据库和运行角色：

```sh
cd services/storefront
python3 scripts/init-secrets.py
cp .env.example .env
docker compose config --quiet
docker compose build api
docker compose up -d --wait postgres
docker compose --profile maintenance run --rm maintenance migrate
docker compose --profile maintenance run --rm maintenance grant-runtime
docker compose up -d --wait api worker
```

另开终端，在仓库根目录启动前端：

```sh

c22dev/muguet.content:
# Muguet
A native Mach-O iOS/macOS port of GTA V, with multiplayer

## How does this work ?
this whole port relies on the WebAssembly compilation of the game. in a browser, that `game.wasm` runs inside the JS engine, behind WebGPU, Web Audio, web workers...
Muguet throws that layer away and runs the same `game.wasm` as a regular native app, with [wasmtime](https://wasmtime.dev) for the code and [wgpu](https://wgpu.rs) on Metal for the graphics

On macOS, the game code is compiled to native arm64 the first time you launch it, then cached. On iOS, we can't properly do that (i dont rlly want you to deal with the hassle of enabling JIT), so the game code is compiled when you build the app and baked into it

On top of that, Muguet adds a small UDP multiplayer (for other people who have the same port to play with you)

## Game files
Because I care about me not getting sued, you will need your own copy as a `.zip` : the folder holding `data/` and `b/<build>/` (with `game.wasm` and `shaders/`)

It's basically the same source as the web port.

Muguet itself will then asks for that zip

## Requirements
- Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 14 or later
- Rust toolchain
- Xcode 26 or later

For iOS, also :
- `rustup` with `rustup toolchain install 1.98.1` and `rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios --toolchain 1.98.1`
- `xcodegen` (`brew install xcodegen`)
- an Apple developer account
- a device on iOS 15 or later, ideally 8 GB of RAM

## Building
The easy way, paste this in Terminal :
```
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/c22dev/muguet/main/build.sh)"
```
It downloads Muguet into `/tmp/muguet`, installs what's missing (Homebrew, Rust...), then asks whether you want the Mac or the iOS version and walks you through the rest. The `.app` / `.ipa` end up in `~/Downloads/muguetOutput`. Already have the repo ? Double-click `build.command`, or run `./build.sh`

You need Xcode 26 or later from the App Store. To install on your iPhone / iPad, sign in to Xcode with your Apple ID (Settings > Accounts), a free one works

By hand, macOS :
```
./make-app.sh
```
gives `build/Muguet.app`

iOS :
```
TEAM=<your team id> ./make-ios.sh game.zip --install
```
`--ipa` makes `build/Muguet.ipa` instead. With a free account, add `FREE=1` (+ a `BUNDLE_ID` of your own)

Please install this app with AltStore. This probably won't work well with Sideloadly (or even SideStore, as per [this issue])(https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/issues/1616)

The app also works with a paid developer account.

## Multiplayer
One player hosts from the launcher (or runs `muguet-server` on any machine), the others join with that address. UDP port 47520

## Limitations
- iOS needs the increased memory limit entitlement
- Story missions are single player only

## Credits
- [divyanshugarg36](https://github.com/divyanshugarg36) for lots of iOS fixes and improvements

# Roast Room

![The Roast Room](docs/room.jpg)

Bring a hard business decision and seven AI advisors argue it out, then hand you a scored verdict and a one-click PDF. The seats are Jeff Bezos, Paul Graham, Alex Hormozi, Gary Vaynerchuk, Dan Martell, Gino Wickman, and Warren Buffett, each built from that person's public work: their letters, essays, talks, and videos. The council runs in Claude Code, and a small local web app shows them around a table talking it through.

| Seat | Pillar | The question they own |
|---|---|---|
| Jeff Bezos | Strategy and decisions | Is this the right bet, and how reversible is it? |
| Paul Graham | Product and startups | Do people actually want this, and is it growing? |
| Alex Hormozi | Offers, pricing, and sales | Will people pay, how much, and how do we close? |
| Gary Vaynerchuk | Marketing and attention | Where does the attention come from? |
| Dan Martell | People, hiring, and founder time | Who does this, and what does it cost your calendar? |
| Gino Wickman | Operations and scaling | Can the business run this without you holding it together? |
| Warren Buffett | Money and capital | What does it do to cash, risk, and long-term value? |

## What you need

- [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). Your Claude plan covers it; no API key needed.
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) 20 or newer, for the room. There's nothing to install beyond that.

## Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nateherkai/roast-room.git
cd roast-room
```

Or open Claude Code anywhere and say: "Clone github.com/nateherkai/roast-room and start the room for me."

## Run a roast

1. Start the room: `npm start`, then open http://localhost:4730. Leave it open.
2. Open Claude Code in the same folder: `claude`
3. Type `/roast-room` and your decision.
4. Answer the Chair's questions, then watch the council argue it out in the room.
5. When the verdict lands, click **Download PDF**.

You also get a short verdict in Claude Code, and the full report lands in `sessions/<date>-<decision>/verdict.md`.

## What to put in your question

The council is only as good as what you give it. Include:

- **The decision** in one line.
- **Your options.** Two or three. "Keep doing what I do now" counts.
- **Your numbers.** Revenue, cash, and team size.
- **Your limits.** Deadline, hours, and budget.
- **What success looks like**, and by when.
- **Which way you're leaning**, and why. The council tests your lean instead of agreeing with it.

Left something out? The Chair asks before the council starts. Example:

```
/roast-room I run a coaching business at $30k a month with 15 clients at $2,000 each.
Should I raise to $3,500 for everyone, raise for new clients only, or keep $2,000?
Close rate is about 50% and I have $40k in the bank. Success is $45k a month by March.
I'm leaning toward raising for everyone because I'm underpaid.
```

More ways to run it:

- `/roast-room --quick ...` seats four advisors for two rounds. Use it for smaller, reversible calls.…

# Macintosh Skeletal Filled

![hellllllo](images/hero.png)

The famoussss handwriting from Apple's **"hello"** screen, as fonts you can type with.

macOS 27 and iOS 27 ship a font called **Macintosh Skeletal** for the
personalized hello you see when setting up a new Mac or iPhone. On its own it
only contains the centre line of each stroke. Apple's renderer thickens those
strokes into tubes and joins the letters live. This project rebuilds what that
renderer draws as ordinary filled fonts, with joins that follow Apple's
renderer.

## Fonts

| File | Family | Weights |
|---|---|---|
| `fonts/MacintoshSkeletalVariable.otf` | Macintosh Skeletal Variable | Variable, `wght` 100 to 900 |
| `fonts/MacintoshSkeletalFilled.otf` | Macintosh Skeletal Filled | Static, Apple's on-screen weight |

Both fonts have two options, off by default: **Crossing o** and **Join
every letter** ([see below](#options)). With both off you get Apple's design.

### Variable weight

![weights](images/weights.png)

![weight axis](images/weights.gif)

Weight is the pen thickness. Apple's renderer draws the font's strokes at
**1.55×** their stored radius, so that is the default (**Regular**).

| Style | `wght` | Pen thickness |
|---|---|---|
| Thin | 100 | 0.6× |
| Light | 270 | 1.0× (the raw font data) |
| **Regular** | **500** | **1.55× (Apple's hello screen)** |
| Bold | 690 | 2.0× |
| Black | 900 | 2.5× |

Any value in between works. Thickness is linear in `wght`, so every app shows
the same result.

### Static or variable?

- **Static (Macintosh Skeletal Filled):** strokes are merged into one clean
  outline per glyph, and where two strokes meet the corner is softly
  blended, the way Apple's renderer does it. Choose this for the closest look
  to the hello screen.
- **Variable (Macintosh Skeletal Variable):** any weight from Thin to Black.
  Each stroke is its own round tube, overlapping the others, so junctions are
  a plain crease rather than a soft blend.

## Options

Both fonts have two options. They are off by default, and you can switch
each one on or off on its own, for any part of your text.

### Crossing o

![Crossing o off and on](images/options-crossing-o.png)

The `o` from Apple's 2020 hello greetings: the bowl starts at the top, and
its end curls back inside and leaves through the bowl, rising straight into
the next letter. It's used before `l`, `b`, `h`, `k` and `f`, where the 2020
greetings use it (`hola`, `olá`, `dobar`); every other `o` stays Apple's.

### Join every letter

![Join every letter off and on](images/options-join.png)

In Apple's design, some letters don't join the letter after them (see
[below](#why-some-letters-dont-join)). This option joins them all. It
replaces the separate *Macintosh Skeletal Variable Joined* font: if you
installed it, you can remove it in Font Book.

### How to switch them on

**Pages, Keynote, TextEdit:** select the text, press **⌘T** (Format › Font ›
Show Fonts), click the **⋯** button at the top left of the Fonts window …
