# 龙湖天街自动签到

一个自带 Web 看板的龙湖会员每日签到服务。**导入一次凭据，之后全自动**——token 会在每次执行时自动续期，不用反复抓包，也不依赖青龙面板。

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.11-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white)
![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-0.115-009688?logo=fastapi&logoColor=white)
![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-ready-2496ED?logo=docker&logoColor=white)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green)
[![LINUX DO](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E7%A4%BE%E5%8C%BA-LINUX%20DO-1f6feb)](https://linux.do)

![看板预览](docs/screenshot.png)

## 目录

- [为什么需要抓一次包](#为什么需要抓一次包)
- [功能特性](#功能特性)
- [快速开始](#快速开始)
- [抓包获取 token](#抓包获取-token)
- [导入账号](#导入账号)
- [使用说明](#使用说明)
- [配置项](#配置项)
- [HTTP API](#http-api)
- [工作原理](#工作原理)
- [成长值与会员等级](#成长值与会员等级)
- [目录结构](#目录结构)
- [数据与备份](#数据与备份)
- [常见问题](#常见问题)
- [安全提醒](#安全提醒)
- [社区](#社区)
- [免责声明](#免责声明)

## 为什么需要抓一次包

龙湖的账号体系里，手机号只是**绑定在微信身份上的附属信息**，不是独立登录凭证。这一点经过实测确认：

| 探测接口 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `/api/passport/wxLogin/v1/sendSms`（不带 ticket） | `900700 绑定有效期已过，请返回后重新绑定` |
| `/api/passport/wxLogin/v1/check`（空参数） | `20001 三方类型不能为空；临时凭证不能为空；应用id不能为空` |
| 全站 `thirdType` 取值 | 只有一个：`wx-pub` |
| 密码登录接口 | 不存在（`setPassword` / `forgetPassword` 属于钱包支付密码） |

整个 passport 模块只有 4 个接口，`ticket` 必须由微信客户端生成的 `authCode` 换取，脚本无法凭空构造。所以**做不成「手机号 + 验证码」直接登录**，任何声称能这么做的方案都是假的。

但这件事只影响「第一次」。token 可以滚动续期，导入一次之后服务会自己续，**不需要长期抓包**。

## 功能特性

- **多账号管理**：一个面板管多个龙湖账号，卡片式展示
- **三种导入方式**：粘贴 cURL / 上传 HAR / 直接填 token，提交时立即校验，不留脏数据
- **token 自动续期**：每次执行前滚动续期，有效期重置为 30 天 → 导入一次后不会再过期
- **随机签到窗口**：默认在 08:00–09:00 之间随机取一个时刻执行，每天不同，页面上改完立即生效，无需重启
- **状态看板**：成长值、等级、珑珠余额、token 剩余天数、签到历史
- **严格三态判定**：区分「签到成功 / 今日已签 / 鉴权失败」，不会把失败当成功（这是很多同类脚本的隐患）
- **失败告警**：续期或签到失败时推送 **Bark / 企业微信 / 钉钉**，类型自动识别
- **零外部依赖**：SQLite 单文件存储，一个容器跑完，不需要数据库和青龙

## 快速开始

### Docker Compose（推荐）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ken861222/longhu-checkin.git
cd longhu-checkin

docker compose up -d --build
```

打开 `http://你的IP:8088` 即可。数据落在 `./data/longhu.db`。

> `docker-compose.yml` 里默认用清华 pip 源加速构建。如果在海外服务器构建，把 `PIP_INDEX_URL` 那行删掉会更快。

### Docker CLI

```bash
docker build -t longhu-checkin .

docker run -d --name longhu-checkin \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  -p 8088:8000 \
  -v $(pwd)/data:/data \
  -e TZ=Asia/Shanghai \
  longhu-checkin
```

### 从源码运行

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate        # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt

DATA_DIR=./data uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
```

需要 Python 3.10+（用到了 `dict | None` 语法）。

## 抓包获取 token

这是整个流程里唯一需要手工操作的环节，做完一次就不用再碰。

### 要抓的是什么

你要抓的是**微信小程序「龙湖」的业务请求**。以下特征可以帮你确认抓对了：

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 请求域名 | `gw2c-hw-open.longfor.com` |
| 小程序 appid | `wx50282644351869da` |
| 关键请求头 | `X-LF-UserToken`（32 位十六进制） |
| 签到接口 | `POST /lmarketing-task-api-mvc-prod/openapi/task/v1/signature/clock` |

### 环境准备

- 一台电脑：macOS 或 Windows
- **微信 PC 版**（能打开小程序；Mac 版微信 3.8+ 也可以）
- 抓包工具：macOS 推荐 [Proxyman](https://proxyman.io/)（免费版够用），Windows 推荐 [Reqable](https://reqable.com/)，也可用 Charles / Fiddle…

# teardown

A Claude Code skill that turns any machine into a 3D simulator you can take apart.

Ask how something works. Claude builds it as one offline HTML page: the machine runs in the middle, every panel around it reads the real numbers, a button opens the part doing the work, and when nobody touches it the page tours itself.

![Mellis HB-7 robotic bee simulator](docs/bee.gif)

| Telson SC-8 robotic scorpion | Pelagos OC-8 robotic octopus |
|---|---|
| ![Telson SC-8 robotic scorpion](docs/scorpion.gif) | ![Pelagos OC-8 robotic octopus](docs/octopus.gif) |

## Install

```
npx skills add elvarofficial/teardown -g -a claude-code
```

Then, once, in the installed folder:

```
npm install && npx playwright install chromium
```

You need Node.js 20 or newer. For the video you also need `ffmpeg`, and for the sound Python 3.

## Use

Ask Claude Code in plain words:

> Build me a simulator of a 4-stroke motorcycle engine I can take apart.

> How does a mechanical watch keep time? Show me as a simulator.

> Make a teardown of a hydraulic excavator arm and record a 20-second video of it.

Or open one of the 3 examples first:

```
node sims/build.mjs v8-live          # teardown-out/dist/v8-live.html
node sims/build.mjs cessna-live
node sims/build.mjs strandbeest-live
```

## What is inside

| | |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | What Claude reads: how a machine is built, the rules that make it look right, the review loop. |
| `sims/kit/` | Runtime, stage, shader warm-up. |
| `sims/v8-*`, `sims/cessna-*`, `sims/strandbeest-*` | 3 complete machines. `-shared` is the machine, `-live` the page you drive, `-film` the recorded tour. |
| `sims/build.mjs` | Bundles a machine into one HTML file, three.js and fonts inlined. |
| `sims/capture.mjs` | Renders the film frame by frame to a 60 fps mp4, or to review sheets of stills. |
| `sfx/`, `run_sfx.py` | Procedural sound on the film's timeline, mastered to −14 LUFS. |

## Credits

Built on [whaleyxbt/claude-motion](https://github.com/whaleyxbt/claude-motion) (MIT): the runtime, frame capture, sound engine and review rules come from there. Recorded samples are CC0 from Freesound, prepared by [Barty-Bart/motion-graphics](https://github.com/Barty-Bart/motion-graphics); sources in `sfx/samples/SOURCES.md`.

MIT licence.

reanimate

Reverse-engineer animations you like. Build your own on top.
A Claude Code skill that works from a live site, a screen recording, an mp4, a gif or a Lottie file.

A short demo. Watch the full video.

A lot of good ideas start on someone else's site. Ask an agent to rebuild one from a link or a screenshot and it makes one pass, calls it done, and misses.    **Unity** (v6 or later)
   1. Unzip the download. It should contain the file `com.ramenvr.autopilot-<version>.tgz`.
   2. Open your project. In Window > Package Management > Package Manager, choose + > Install package from tarball..., and pick that file.
   3. Open Window > Autopilot.

   **Godot** (v4.7 or later)
   1. Unzip the download. Move `autopilot/` into your project's `addons/` folder.
   2. Open your project. Enable Autopilot in Project > Project Settings > Plugins. The Autopilot dock appears on the right.

3. Follow the Autopilot setup flow.
   1. We recommend using Autopilot with your Aura account. Click `Create Account` if you don't yet have an Aura account, or `Sign in` if you are a returning user.
   2. Autopilot runs its setup, and finally redirects you to the signup/signin page. Complete your signin/signup process.
   3. Upon successful authentication, you should see the "Agent service ready" page. Click Continue.
   4. You have the option to enable/disable sharing your runs to improve Autopilot. As the developers of Autopilot, we would of course appreciate your enabling this!
   5. (Optional) Run the 10-minute exploration run to populate your Autopilot project memory. It is safe to skip this and jump straight to sending your own prompt.
   6. Prompt Autopilot! See the types of prompts you can try in [Usage](./README.md#usage).

# NOIR

[![build](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Verlintas/NOIR)](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Verlintas/NOIR)](LICENSE)
![platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-macOS%20%7C%20Windows%20%7C%20Linux-2ea44f)

**把「这台手机到底能泄露什么」变成一份可复现的报告。**

NOIR 是一个跑在电脑上的审计工具，通过 `adb` 读取已连接 Android 设备的应用清单、权限和 APK 里的网络端点，给出分类、风险评分和可执行的处置建议。它也可以在需要时调用 `jadx` 对单个应用做反编译和关键字检索。

> 定位：**审计与自我防护**。面向自己的设备、自己的应用、已授权的安全研究。

---

## 它做什么

1. **盘点**：列出所有「有网络权限 + 敏感权限」的应用，以及它们各自拿到了什么。
2. **抽取端点**：在设备端用 `unzip + strings` 从每个 APK 的 dex 里提取 URL，只回传几 KB，不把整包拉回电脑。
3. **分类与打分**：按包名和域名识别厂商（Xiaomi / Google / 腾讯 / 高德 …）与类别（遥测、广告、定位、输入法 …），结合权限和上报端点计算风险分。
4. **数据关联**：把权限翻译成"能拿到什么数据"（位置/通讯录/短信/通话/麦克风/相机/屏幕/应用列表/设备标识/文件/日历/账号），再和上报域名配对，得出"哪类数据可能流向哪里"。
5. **共享 UID**：识别 `android.uid.system` 这类共享用户，列出哪些包实际上共享同一套权限并集。
6. **清单层**：解析 `AndroidManifest.xml` 二进制 AXML，找出没有权限保护的导出组件、明文流量、备份、debuggable、targetSdk。
4. **给建议**：区分「可安全自动执行」「需人工确认」「不建议动」，并为每条动作生成回滚命令。
5. **必要时深挖**：`deep` 会把单个 APK 拉到本地，用 `jadx` 反编译后检索 `Runtime.exec`、`setApplicationEnabledSetting`、`DexClassLoader`、`MediaProjection` 等高风险调用。

## 它不做什么

- 不联网、不上传任何数据、不需要账号。
- 不修改系统分区，不需要 root。
- 不会自动卸载任何东西，除非你显式加 `--aggressive`。

---

## 第一次运行

```bash
noir
```

不带参数会进入向导：

1. 检查 `adb`，没有就**问你要不要自动下载**（`~/.noir/tools`）
2. 检查设备，没有就打印**开发者模式 / USB 调试的开通步骤**，然后**等你插线**（最多 180 秒）
3. 问一句「开始扫描?」，扫完直接出仪表盘
4. 问一句「执行这 19 条安全处置?」，`y` 就执行，并写好回滚文件

全程只会问两三个 y/n，其余都是自动的。

## 环境自检

```bash
noir doctor
```

```
NOIR doctor
  platform  Mac OS X aarch64
  java      17.0.19
  adb       /opt/homebrew/.../platform-tools/adb
            Version 37.0.1-15733141
  device    178b0d2f  device  2509FPN0BC
  jadx      /opt/homebrew/bin/jadx
```

```bash
noir setup          # 缺什么下什么
noir setup --yes    # 不询问，适合脚本
```

## 出现问题时

所有错误都会带「怎么办」，而不是抛异常栈：

```
╭─ ERROR ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ 指定的 adb 不存在：/nonexistent/adb                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 检查路径，或运行 noir setup 自动安装。                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

没有设备时给出的是可执行步骤：

```
╭─ 没有检测到设备 ──────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│  1. 打开开发者模式                                           │
│     小米 / HyperOS：设置 → 我的设备 → 全部参数 → 连点「MIUI 版本」7 次
│  2. 开启 USB 调试：设置 → 系统 → 开发者选项 → USB 调试        │
│  3. 插线后手机弹「允许 USB 调试吗？」→ 勾选「一律允许」        │
│  4. 还不行就换一根数据线（很多线只能充电）                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

已连接但没授权时，会单独提示「撤销 USB 调试授权后重插」。

# gputaskman

**An `htop` for what's inside your GPU, not just how full it is.**

Windows + NVIDIA. A terminal UI that connects per-process GPU memory and engine activity
with loaded runtimes, model files, and LLM buffer breakdowns.

Task Manager says "15 GB used." This tries to answer: *by what? Model weights? KV cache?
Your browser? The desktop compositor? And why is so much GPU memory in system RAM?*

**Scope: local GPU workloads, not cloud services.** Decision models, vision, speech, LLM inference,
training/fine-tuning (including Unsloth), graphics, and video all belong here. Visibility varies:
process memory and engine activity are measured; identifying individual models and their work
requires supporting evidence. A PyTorch/CUDA DLL alone cannot identify a model or prove training,
and a mapped file does not prove that model is resident on the GPU or being exercised.
CPU-only, NPU-only, and cloud workloads are out of scope.

![Live GPU overview with an LLM's weights, KV cache, and compute buffer breakdown](docs/screenshots/overview.png)

> Early, experimental software. Device and process counters are measurements; classifications
> and GGUF-derived breakdowns are estimates. This does not dump VRAM or enumerate a game's textures.

## Portable Windows download

The [Releases page](https://github.com/shanselman/gputaskman/releases) is where tagged builds
publish two portable ZIPs: `gputaskman-VERSION-windows-x64.zip` for Intel/AMD Windows PCs, and
`gputaskman-VERSION-windows-arm64.zip` for native Windows ARM64. These are separate native builds,
not a universal executable. If no release is published yet, use the source instructions below.

Extract the **entire ZIP**, keeping `_internal` beside `gputaskman.exe`. Open Windows Terminal
or PowerShell in the extracted folder:

```powershell
.\gputaskman.exe
.\gputaskman.exe --once
.\gputaskman.exe --json
```

No Python, uv, CUDA Toolkit, model download, or installation is needed. An NVIDIA GPU with a
current Windows WDDM driver is still required. Builds are currently **unsigned**; code signing
and an installer are not part of this initial distribution. Each ZIP includes licenses and a
`.zip.sha256` companion file is published for integrity checks.

## Clone and run

Use **64-bit Windows 10/11**, an **NVIDIA GPU with a current WDDM driver**, and a terminal
(Windows Terminal is recommended). Live workload checks have included an RTX 4080 SUPER and an
RTX Spark N1X on Windows ARM64. CUDA workloads are supported on ARM64 with a compatible NVIDIA
driver and ARM64 CUDA runtime.

Install [Git for Windows](https://git-scm.com/downloads/win) and
[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) if needed. With WinGet:

```powershell
winget install --id Git.Git --exact
winget install --id astral-sh.uv --exact
```

Open a new PowerShell window so those tools are on `PATH`, then:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/shanselman/gputaskman.git
cd gputaskman
uv run --locked gputaskman
```

TallyBar

A free, local-only time tracker for freelancers. It lives in the macOS menu bar.
One click to start, a real PDF invoice at the end of the month, no account.

## The problem Most time trackers want an account, a monthly fee and a copy of your client list on someone else's server. For a solo freelancer the job is much smaller: know what you worked on, know when you stopped, and turn it into an invoice. TallyBar does that and nothing else. Your data is one JSON file on your Mac. The app makes no network connections at all. ## What it does - **One click per client.** Click a client to start. Click another to switch. Click again to stop. - **Global hotkey.** Control-Option-Command-T starts and stops from anywhere, and it needs no Accessibility permission. - **Idle detection.** "You were away 23m. Keep or discard?" Sleep and wake are covered, and so is a crash or power cut. - **Rates and totals.** Per-client hourly rates and currencies, daily and weekly totals, and a weekly goal ring. - **PDF invoices.** Drawn natively, with pagination, tax, payment terms and your details. - **CSV export.** Correct quoting, spreadsheet formula protection, and timestamps that stay unambiguous during daylight saving changes. - **Correct time math.** Sessions that cross midnight land on the right days. 23 and 25 hour days add up. Money is `Decimal`, never a float. - **Mac native.** SwiftUI, light and dark mode, VoiceOver labels, launch at login. | Timesheet | Idle prompt | | --- | --- | | ![Timesheet window with entries grouped by day](docs/images/timesheet.png) | ![Prompt reading: You were away 23m](docs/images/idle-prompt.png) | ## Install ### Download (Apple Silicon) 1. # mutant.cafe

![MUTANT CAFE: a feral rat leaping a row of snap traps, some sprung and some not](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelhooks/mutant-cafe/main/assets/banner.jpg)

Mutation testing for [Effect](https://effect.website) TypeScript. mutant.cafe reads your types, breaks your functions in ways that still type-check, runs the tests related to each break, and lists the breaks your tests miss.

It is inspired by [cargo-mutants](https://mutants.rs) by Martin Pool ([source](https://github.com/sourcefrog/cargo-mutants), MIT). The core idea, replacing a function body with a plausible value of its return type and reporting what the tests don't notice, comes from cargo-mutants, and so does the operator experience: a baseline run first, a scratch copy of your tree, per-mutant timeouts, `--in-diff`, and a `mutants.out` directory of results. mutant.cafe ports those ideas to Effect; it shares no code with cargo-mutants.

## What it adds for Effect

An `Effect<A, E, R>` declares its failures in `E`. For each tagged error in `E`, mutant.cafe makes a mutant that swallows that error and succeeds instead. If no value of `A` can be synthesized, a separate `TagToDefect` mutant turns that tag into a defect. That is not a successful recovery: it checks whether tests distinguish typed failures from defects, rather than only asserting `Exit.isFailure`.

Other mutants, all chosen from the checker's view of the return type:

- `Effect.succeed(value)` for plausible values of `A`, `Effect.fail` of each tag, `Effect.die`, and `Effect.never` behind a measured timeout
- `Option.none()` and `Option.some(value)`
- `Stream.empty`, a one-element stream, and a failing stream
- a `Layer` that dies at build, even when its error type is `never`, plus one failing build per error tag
- flipped booleans and cycled literal unions

## Use it

Needs Node 24 or later, a `tsconfig.json`, and a vitest suite that passes.

```sh
npm install -D mutant-cafe
npx mutant-cafe --list      # preview the mutants
npx mutant-cafe --jobs 4    # test them
```

It mutates internal functions by default, including `Effect.fn` and `Effect.fnUntraced`, object-literal arrows, service methods inside Layers, and the inner function of a curried export. Layer values and static Layer properties are targets too. Names follow their path, such as `Greeter.layer.greet`, `policy.canEdit`, and `guardFor.<inner>`. With `--exported-only`, targets must be reachable through an exported binding path: exported top-level functions, methods and functions in exported values, returned curried functions, and exported Layers with their returned service methods. Local declarations and arrows inside other function bodies are internal, even if their owner is exported. This keeps local helpers out without dropping exported object or service APIs.

Value synthesis includes branded strings and numbers, empty sets and maps, anonymous objects with cycled literal fields, and same-typed parameters as identity replacements. Naked type-pa…

# Metroid Prime 4 Recomp — native Linux build (AppImage)

A native PC build of **your own copy** of *Metroid Prime 4: Beyond* for Linux, packaged as a single AppImage. It is built
on the SwitchRecomp runtime by MZ Labs: the game's Switch code is recompiled ahead of time into a native Linux library on your machine, and the
Switch GPU's work is translated to OpenGL 4.6.

This release is the result of a long stretch of play-testing and fixing: the game boots, plays, scans, sounds right and
runs at a steady 60 fps on the test machine, with most of the rendering bugs and stutters found along the way fixed.
Everything that changed is listed below.

> **No Nintendo files are included.** No game code, no RomFS, no keys, no generated C. You need your own legally
> obtained, dumped copy of the game. The AppImage holds the runtime, the recompiler and a bundled GCC and Python; it
> compiles the game from your files during the first-run setup. The only game-related file inside is a manifest of
> RomFS file names, sizes and SHA-1 hashes, used to verify your dump.

---

  - [Gameplay fixes](#gameplay-fixes)
  - [Audio](#audio)

---

## Requirements

- **Linux, any x86-64 CPU** (Steam Deck included), glibc 2.38 or newer. X11, or Wayland through XWayland.
- **GPU:** an OpenGL 4.3+ driver (Mesa or NVIDIA). Developed and tested on an **AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT** with Mesa 26.2
  (radeonsi).
- **SDL2** (controllers and audio) and **zlib**, which most distributions already ship.
- **For the game's videos:** OpenH264 2.x (`openh264` / `libopenh264`), or FFmpeg's `libavcodec` (faster, preferred when
  present). VA-API hardware decoding is used when available. Without any of these, videos stay black.
- **Your game dump:** *Metroid Prime 4: Beyond* for Switch, program `010019A01E2F2000`, with the update whose main has build

# switch2mac

Native Mac builds of Nintendo Switch 2 games on Apple silicon, made from **your own dump** on your own Mac.

switch2mac is a fork of [nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative), carried forward for Switch 2: NVN2 graphics on Metal, Switch 2 mesh and task shaders, movies, many shader translator fixes, and the performance work that took the first game from 20 to about 58 fps. It is not an emulator: the game's own ARM64 code runs directly on the Mac, rewritten so its system calls land in a native runtime, and every shader is translated to Metal ahead of time.

**Mario Kart World 1.0.0** is the first game built and tuned this way. The kit is laid out for more: each game is a folder under [`games/`](games), and [docs/porting.md](docs/porting.md) explains how to bring up the next one, with everything learned so far. You can follow it yourself in Terminal, or hand it to an AI coding assistant ([AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)).

| Game | Version | Status | On an M1 Max |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mario Kart World | 1.0.0 | Plays start to finish: menus, Grand Prix, free roam, traffic, movies | ~58 fps in races (Performance mode), 2560x1440 |
| Mario Kart World | later updates | **Untested** | — |
| Your game? | | [docs/porting.md](docs/porting.md) | |

> This repository holds no game content. You need a dump of a game you own; what the build makes from it must not be shared. See [LEGAL.md](LEGAL.md).

## What you get (Mario Kart World)

`Mario Kart World.app`: a normal, double-clickable Mac app that carries everything it needs (it keeps working after you delete the build folder).

- Opens straight into the game, windowed or full screen.
- **Key 1**: the performance overlay (top right). Compact (FPS + resolution) → detailed (30-second FPS graph, GPU time, frame time, CPU, memory, the game's frame pacing) → off.
- **Key 2**: the settings panel (Esc closes it). Display, Performance and Controls; the overlay and full screen change at once, the rest at the next launch.
- Controllers (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro and others macOS recognises) and the keyboard.
- Saves in `~/Library/Application Support/nxnative/0400C3F00006E000/save`, the log in `~/Library/Logs/nxnative/0400C3F00006E000.log`.

## What you need

- A Mac with Apple silicon and **macOS 26.6 or later** (older versions refuse to open the app; tested: M1 Max, 64 GB, macOS 26.6). The game uses about 13-16 GB of memory.
- **Xcode** with the Metal toolchain (Xcode → Settings → Components), and its command line tools.
- **.NET 10 SDK** ([dot.net](https://dot.net)): the shader translator runs on it.
- **Python 3.12 or newer** (python.org or Homebrew).
- About 50 GB free disk space during the build (the game image is 22 GB; on the same APFS disk the app shares it instead of copying it).
- Your dump of Mario Kart World 1.0.0: a folder with `exefs/` (main, main.npdm, sdk, subsdk0, rtld) and `romfs/`, or `base/exefs` and `base/romfs`. Already extracted, as dump tools write it: switch2mac needs no keys and de…

# Claude Animated Shorts

The free Claude skill from the video **"How to Make Viral Animated Shorts Using Claude (Full Workflow)"**.

It makes 55-70 s vertical animated story shorts: 2D characters in a colourful 3D world, with ink outlines, a painted town, lens blur, gliding cameras, a march score and sound effects. Everything is rendered with three.js inside Remotion on your own PC, with no AI video generator.

Proven on **The Bridge That Fell for a Song**, a 67 s short about the 1831 Broughton bridge.

## What's inside
| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | The skill: the full pipeline, every rule, every fix, and the final look values |
| `templates/bridge/` | The full source of the bridge short: world, characters, ink, lens blur, grade, story/camera |
| `templates/audio/` | The synthesized sound: SFX, march music, the mix with ducking and loudness |
| `templates/scripts/` | Stills, side-by-side sheets, shot merge and frame-by-frame QA helpers |
| `references/STYLE_BIBLE.md` | The script and visual formula measured from 20 reference shorts |
| `references/reports/` | Seven measured reports: motion, depth, textures, characters, lighting, outlines, grade |
| `references/frames/` | 38 full-size reference frames (540x960) to compare your frames against |
| `references/sheets/` | 20 contact sheets, one per reference short, 60 frames each (1,200 frames) |

## Install
1. Copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/cartoon-3d-short/` (clone it there, or download the ZIP).
2. You need [Remotion](https://www.remotion.dev/) with `@remotion/three`, plus Node, Python 3 and ffmpeg.
3. In Claude Code, say: *"Use the cartoon short skill and make a short about …"*.

Claude then follows `SKILL.md`: topic and facts, then script, then voice, then the shot plan in `story.ts`, then stills, then renders. Agents check your frames against the reports and the frames, and you get the final 2K render and sound mix.

## Notes
- Set `REMOTION_TMP` to a folder on a big drive. Every Remotion bundle copies `public/` (~1.3 GB) into the temp folder.
- Story, characters and voice should always be your own. Use the references for the look, not the content.

## License
The code and docs are MIT (see `LICENSE`). The reference frames are included for style study only.

# Idol **A single image to 3DGS object model** Idol turns one picture of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat. Give it a render, a generated image or a photo: it removes the background, frames the object and generates up to 1,048,576 Gaussians, including the sides the picture never showed. It runs on consumer GPUs, using 7.2 GB of VRAM and can run in under 2 seconds.
[![Hugging Face](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%A4%97%20Hugging%20Face-Model-yellow)](https://huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol) [![Hugging Face Spaces](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%A4%97%20Hugging%20Face-Spaces-yellow)](https://huggingface.co/spaces/speridlabs/idol) [![Python 3.10+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.10+-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/downloads/)
| ![](assets/gallery/armchair.webp) | ![](assets/gallery/avocado.webp) | |---|---| | ![](assets/gallery/lamp.webp) | ![](assets/gallery/axolotl.webp) | Each pair: the input image and the generated object turning. The [demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/speridlabs/idol) has 93 more examples ready to run and takes your own images as well. ## Model | | | |---|---| | Output | 3D Gaussians: 32,768 to 1,048,576 (default 262,144), standard 3DGS `.ply` | | DiT | 370M parameters | | Image conditioning | DINOv3 ViT-H+ and FLUX.2 VAE | | Decoder | 288M parameters | | Background removal | BiRefNet | | Sampler | Euler, 50 steps, classifier-free guidance 3.0, time shift 3.0 | ## Install ```bash pip install -e . # Python >= 3.10, PyTorch >= 2.5 pip install -e ".[demo]" # + Gradio, to run the demo locally ``` The weights are downloaded from Hugging Face on first use, you need to request access to [facebook/dinov3-vith16plus-pretrain-lvd1689m](https://huggingface.co/facebook/dinov3-vith16plus-pretrain-lvd1689m) and [black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev) first, then log in with `hf auth login`. `flash-attn`, if installed, is used for attention; otherwise PyTorch's `scaled_dot_product_attention` is (same result, slower). Set `ATTN_BACKEND=sdpa` or `ATTN_BACKEND=flash_attn` to choose. ## Inference ```bash python -m idol.sample --image photo.jpg --mode real python -m idol.sample --image renders/ --mode synthetic --out outputs ``` For each image this writes `.ply` (open it in any Gaussian splat viewer), `_input.png` (the image the model saw, after background removal and cropping) and `_camera.json` (the predicted camera of the input). **Pick the mode for your input:** | `--mode` | for | |---|---| | `synthetic` (default) | computer generated images| | `real` | real world photographs | Other flags: | flag | default | | |---|---|---| | `--seed` | 42 | same seed, same object | | `--steps` | 50 | sampling steps | | `--cfg_strength` | 3.0 | classifier-free guidance | | `--rescale_t` | 3.0 | time shift: higher spends more steps at high noise | | `--num_gaussians` | 262144 | 32,768 to 1,048,576, a multiple o…

eshaangulati123/perfectclone-website-clo.content:
# perfectclone: website cloner that copies the real site, 1:1

**Pull the real frontend of any public site in ~15 seconds. No AI, no tokens.**

![Clone any website. Get the real files. huly.io cloned with perfectclone: 0.00% pixel difference, 14 seconds, 157 files, 0 LLM calls.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eshaangulati123/perfectclone-website-cloner/main/docs/images/huly-live-vs-clone.jpg)

perfectclone clones any website 1:1. It crawls the site with a real browser (Playwright),
downloads the site's own HTML, JavaScript, CSS, fonts and images, and gives you a folder you can
serve, edit and deploy. Then it lets you rebrand it, rehost it and strip the original owner's
trackers without breaking it, including Next.js sites that hydrate on load.

```bash
pip install perfectclone

perfectclone clone example.com
perfectclone serve example.com             # → http://localhost:8000
```

That's it. Chromium is downloaded automatically the first time you clone. Requires Python 3.10+.

Or try it without installing anything, using [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```bash
uvx perfectclone clone example.com
```

## Why not an AI cloner?

Most "clone any website" tools today regenerate the site: an AI agent looks at screenshots or
scraped markup, writes a new React/Next.js app, and compares the result against the original
with a visual-similarity score until it's close enough. That gets you a lookalike. The code is
new, the behaviour is approximate, and there are always gaps.

perfectclone doesn't regenerate anything. It mirrors the bytes the site actually serves, so
the clone *is* the site: same markup, same bundles, same animations, same JavaScript running.
Sometimes the real solution is the simple one.

# instagram-reporting-bot

Telegram: https://t.me/igmasrep

What Is a Instagram Reporting Bot / Automation Tool? ❓

A Instagram reporting bot or automation tool is software designed to simplify and organize the process of submitting reports concerning accounts, pages, profiles, or content that may violate Instagram Terms, Community Standards, or other platform policies.

Instead of manually navigating through multiple reporting screens, an automation system can assist with repetitive, legitimate reporting tasks while keeping the reporting process structured and consistent.

How Does the Reporting System Work? ❓

A typical reporting workflow can contain several stages:

• 1. Target identification — the user specifies the profile, page, post, or other content that needs to be reviewed. • 2. Category selection — the appropriate potential violation category is selected, such as impersonation, spam, harassment, fraudulent behavior, or another applicable policy issue. • 3. Report preparation — the system organizes the relevant information required for the report. • 4. Submission assistance — the tool can automate or simplify repetitive parts of the reporting workflow where permitted. • 5. Platform review — Instagram receives the report and evaluates it through its own moderation and enforcement systems. • 6. Result tracking — where information is made available by Instagram, the user can monitor the status or outcome of submitted reports.

What Is the Algorithm Behind It? ⚙️

A legitimate reporting automation system can be structured around a simple decision workflow: 

Input
  ↓
Target / Content Identification
  ↓
Policy Category Selection
  ↓
Report Information Validation
  ↓
Report Submission
  ↓
Instagram Moderation Systems
  ↓
Review / Decision
  ↓
Status Tracking

The important distinction is that an automation tool can assist with submitting a report, but it legitimately guarantee that an account will be removed. The final decision belongs to Instagram and depends on its policies, evidence, and moderation systems.

What Can the Tool Be Used For? 🔎

Depending on the implementation, a reporting assistant may help users organize reports concerning: • Fake or impersonating profiles • Spam and unwanted content • Harassment or abusive behavior • Fraudulent activity • Misleading or deceptive accounts • Content that potentially violates Instagram Community Standards • Other legitimate policy violations Can a Reporting Bot Guarantee an Account Ban? ❌

legitimate reporting tool can guarantee that a Instagram account, page, or post will be removed. Submitting multiple reports does not automatically establish that a violation occurred, and Instagram ultimately determines whether enforcement action is appropriate.

# 反诈库直查 · frauddb

读取小米 HyperOS 反诈组件留下的本地数据库 `fraud_detection_data.db`，把里面的记录整理成时间线。

只读，不写回数据库，不上传、不联网（检查更新除外），不收集任何数据。

---

## 背景

- 文件路径：`/data/misc/user/0/securitycenter/fraud_detection_data.db`
- 写入方：`com.miui.securitycenter` 中的 `MiFraudDetectionService`（XSOF 涉诈检测）
- 记录内容：截图时间、屏幕共享/录屏、通话、VoIP 通话、应用安装、涉诈链接、飞行模式、呼叫转移
- 保留策略：写入时清理超窗口的旧记录，截图表通常只保留最近 72 小时

这些记录不会出现在任何系统设置界面里，只能通过数据库查看。

## 功能

- **时间线**：所有表的事件倒序混排，按天分组，可按类型筛选
- **表格**：按表查看原始字段
- **统计**：各表记录数、每天截图数、`sqlite_sequence` 累计写入量
- **媒体配对**：把相册里的截图图片与录屏视频按时间戳配到事件上，显示缩略图
- **通话记录**：用号码 MD5 匹配系统通话记录，还原明文号码与联系人
- **恢复模式**：扫描空闲页与页内空闲块，列出已被删除但仍有残留的记录
- **导出**：时间线 TXT / 全量 JSON / 事件 CSV
- **诊断日志**：记录每次 `su` 调用与布局溢出，便于排查读不到文件的原因
- **MD5 探测**：用系统通话记录试几种号码归一化形式，判断库里 `tel_number_md5` 的计算方式
- **检查更新**：查询 GitHub Release 并在应用内下载安装

## 表结构

针对小米 XSOF 涉诈检测库：

```
screenshot(_id, screenshot_time)
screen_share(_id, screen_share_package_name, screen_share_start_time,
             screen_share_end_time, is_active, duration)
fraud_phone(_id, call_start_time, call_end_time, is_fraud_call, tel_location,
            tel_number_md5, operator, is_chinese_number, is_virtual_operator,
            is_active, duration)
voip_record(_id, voip_record_package_name, voip_record_start_time,
            voip_record_end_time, is_active, is_fraud_call, duration)
install_app(_id, pkg_name, app_name, source, version_code, md5,
            install_finish_time, app_tag_id, security_tag_id)
fraud_url(_id, access_time, url_type)
airplane_mode(_id, airplane_mode_on, airplane_mode_change_time)
call_forwarding(_id, reason, enabled, timestamp)
```

字段名从 `sqlite_master` 的建表语句里读，未知表也能在「表格」页展开。

`tel_number_md5` 的算法已经逆出来了，见 [docs/md5-algorithm.md](docs/md5-algorithm.md)：
号码原样取 UTF-8 字节做 MD5，小写十六进制，无盐、无归一化。
因为是裸 MD5，`tools/md5phone.py` 可以按号段枚举号码反查哈希（仅用于验证自己的数据）。

## 使用

**安装 APK**

从 [Releases](https://github.com/acnekot/frauddb/releases) 下载最新的 `frauddb-<版本>.apk` 安装，包名 `com.catsuki.frauddb`。

旧版本不再单独提供下载，历史版本留在 tag 里。包名从 `fkmiui` 改成了 `frauddb`，
属于另一个应用，装新版前请先卸载旧版（旧版里保存的数据集不会迁移）。

**读取数据库**

- 有 root：打开应用后自动尝试五个常见路径，找不到会逐个记录失败原因
- 没有 root：先把文件复制到共享存储，再用「更多 → 选择 db 文件」
- 也可以把数据库拷贝到电脑，用浏览器打开 `web/index.html`，通过文件选择器加载

**权限**

| 权限 | 用途 | 不授予时 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` / `READ_MEDIA_VIDEO` | 相册截图与录屏配对、缩略图 | 时间线正常显示，没有缩略图 |
| `READ_CALL_LOG` | 用号码 MD5 匹配系统通话记录 | 通话只显示号码摘要 |

权限在「更多 → 权限」里逐项申请，也可以完全不授权，其余功能照常使用。

## 权限

所有敏感能力按组申请，不给只关掉对应功能，其余照常可用。

| 权限 | 用途 | 不授予时 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` / `READ_MEDIA_VIDEO` | 相册截图与录屏配对、缩略图 | 时间线正常显示，没有缩略图 |
| `READ_CONTACTS` / `READ_CALL_LOG` | 号码还原：算 MD5 与库里的哈希比对 | 通话只显示号码摘要 |

「更多 → 权限」里逐项显示状态，点一下就是系统弹窗。

## 号码还原（默认关闭）

关着时不读通讯录也不读通话记录。打开后读通讯录（上限 5000）和通话记录（上限 800），
对每个号码算「原样」和「去分隔符」两种 MD5，与库里 `tel_number_md5` 比对：
命中就显示明文号码、联系人名与来源；全部在内存里完成，不写盘、不联网。

## 数据保存与合并

默认**不保存**任何东西。开启后每导入一份数据库就**新增一份数据集**，不覆盖——
反诈库按 72 小时滚动清理，不同时间导出的副本内容不同，合并才拼得出完整历史。

- 副本按内容 SHA-1 命名，内容相同只更新时间戳，不重复占空间
- 时间线是**所有数据集的合并视图**，按「类型 + rowid + 时间戳」去重
- 统计页显示数据集份数与合并后的各表记录数；「表格」页看最新那份
- 可单独删除某份，…

# OpenKaraoke **在家，也能好好唱一首歌。** Windows 桌面 K 歌軟體，從製作伴唱、點歌演唱，到錄音與音準回顧。 ![Windows x64](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-x64-0078d4?style=flat-square) [![GPL-3.0-only](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL--3.0--only-2ea98b?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [功能](#功能) · [開始使用](#開始使用) · [使用指南](#使用指南) · [常見問題](#常見問題)
![OpenKaraoke 桌面畫面：版本號、歌曲庫、演唱控制與歌詞開關](docs/assets/overview.png) ## 功能 - **製作自己的伴唱歌曲**：從 YouTube 網址製作歌曲，在本機分離導唱與伴奏；也能匯入 `.opok` 歌曲，並相容舊的 `.openkaraoke`。 - **點歌與管理歌庫**：搜尋歌名或歌手、安排待播順序，支援重唱及自動下一首。 - **調整演唱音效**：切換導唱／伴奏、升降調與迴聲，支援全螢幕演唱。 - **匯入同步歌詞**：加入歌曲時可匯入歌詞，選擇滾動或 KTV 逐字顯示，並在「設定 → 顯示」調整字體大小。 - **用電腦或手機收音**：電腦音訊輸入與手機來源二擇一；手機不需安裝 App，最多兩支共同演唱。 - **查看音準表現**：旋律音條隨歌曲捲動，音符完成後呈現紅綠結果，提供三種評分難度。 - **回顧這次演唱**：同步聆聽音樂與人聲錄音、查看音準記錄，並可下載錄音。 ## 開始使用 到 [Releases](https://github.com/tm3u/OpenKaraoke/releases/latest) 下載 Windows x64 執行版，再依下列步驟開始使用： 1. **開啟程式**：完整解壓縮 `OpenKaraoke-Standalone-win-x64.zip`，執行最外層的 `OpenKaraoke.exe`，不需另外安裝 .NET。請保留隨附資料夾。 2. **加入歌曲**：匯入 `.opok` 或舊的 `.openkaraoke`，或輸入 YouTube 網址、歌名與歌手，加入處理清單。 3. **開始演唱**：歌曲完成後按「＋」加入待播清單，再按播放。 首次製作會下載必要 AI 元件，需要網路與數 GB 空間；處理清單會獨立顯示元件準備進度。AI 在本機執行，支援時使用 NVIDIA GPU，否則使用 CPU。已有歌曲可離線播放、搜尋及匯入。 ## 使用指南 [加入歌曲](#加入與管理歌曲) · [演唱控制](#演唱控制) · [評分與回顧](#評分與回顧) · [麥克風設定](#麥克風設定) · [手機設定](#手機麥克風設定) · [資料與備份](#資料與備份) ### 加入與管理歌曲 按「加入歌曲」選擇製作或匯入： - **製作歌曲**：輸入 YouTube 網址，按「讀取影片」，確認歌名與歌手後加入處理清單。只取得完整原片，忽略網址的時間、區間及清單參數；Clip 分享網址會解析為原片。 - **匯入歌曲**：選擇 `.opok` 或舊的 `.openkaraoke` 檔案。程式會在自己的資料目錄建立 `歌名_歌手.opok` 副本，之後不依賴原始匯入檔案的位置。既有歌庫中的 `.openkaraoke` 仍可播放，不會自動更動原檔。 歌名與歌手會清除前後空白，保留中間空格。歌曲工作依序處理，可取消或重試；關閉視窗仍會繼續背景處理，重新啟動可接續未完成工作。 「加入歌曲」的歌名、歌手下方可選填歌詞，支援 `.lrc` 與 `.ass`。呈現方式為二擇一：左側「滾動歌詞」預設選取（多行捲動、目前句醒目顯示，逐行時間即可），右側「KTV 逐字」（固定雙行、逐字填色，需要完整逐字或音節時間）。歌詞與模式會封裝在 `.opok` 歌曲檔內，可離線播放；匯入已包含歌詞的新舊歌曲檔時沿用原有歌詞與模式。 有歌詞的歌曲會在 `media/<歌曲編號>/` 另存與歌曲同名的獨立副本：滾動歌詞為 `歌名_歌手.lrc`，KTV 逐字為 `歌名_歌手.ass`，以加入時選定的呈現方式決定格式。格式不同時僅轉換原有文字與時間資料，原始檔案不會被改動。獨立副本供檢視、備份與外部管理；播放仍使用 `.opok` 內的歌詞，修改副本不會自動套用。 歌詞僅能在加入歌曲時匯入。當次未匯入，加入後無法補加；已有歌詞亦不提供更換、編輯、搜尋下載或自動製作功能。請僅匯入您有權使用的歌詞檔案。 首次製作時，「必要 AI 元件」會獨立顯示下載與安裝進度，相依歌曲排在後方等待。元件不能取消，失敗可重試；準備完成後不會重複下載。 ### 演唱控制 在歌曲列按「＋」加入待播清單，成功後短暫顯示勾選。未搜尋時顯示熱門前十首，可搜尋歌名或歌手；待播歌曲可調整順序或移除。 | 控制 | 行為 | | --- | --- | | 播放／暫停／下一首 | 演唱中播放或暫停，結算後切換為下一首；沒有待播歌曲時回到待機。 | | 切歌 | 結束本首並進入結算，捨棄當次評分與錄音，不影響先前紀錄。 | | 重唱 | 從頭開始，先顯示歌名與歌手三秒，歌曲靜音且沒有倒數提示。每首歌曲開始時亦有相同準備時間。 | | 自動播放下一首 | 預設關閉；啟用後在結算停留十秒，再接續下一首。手動按下一首可立即接續。 | | 導唱／伴奏 | 切換歌曲音軌。 | | 顯示歌詞(如果有) | 控制匯入歌詞的顯示／隱藏，與評分系統分別設定；狀態會保存並沿用到下一首。 | | 升降調 | 範圍 −6～＋6 半音；中央「正常調」恢復原調。 | | 迴聲 | 調整人聲迴聲；中央「正常」恢復預設的適量迴聲。 | | 喇叭／麥克風音量 | 底部兩列控制範圍為 0～100，立即生效並保存。兩支手機共用麥克風音量。 | 主歌曲不提供時間跳轉，要從頭演唱請使用「重唱」。 「設定 → 顯示」可調整歌詞字體大小（75%～125%，預設 100%），適用於 KTV 逐字與滾動歌詞。按「套用」後立即更新目前歌詞並保存；取消或關閉設定會捨棄本次調整。 快捷鍵：F11 全螢幕、Esc 離開全螢幕、空白鍵播放／暫停／下一首、Ctrl+1／2 導唱／伴奏、Ctrl+↑／↓ 升降調、Ctrl+0 正常調。輸入文字時不攔截空白鍵。 ### 評分與回顧 評分只計音準，演唱中不公布分數。五條背景線與固定唱歌線協助判讀音高；每條參考音符分析完成後，依整條有效樣本的平均音高偏差，固定顯示綠色或紅色。 成績為「唱準的時間 ÷ 全部參考音符的時間 × 100」，四捨五入為整數，滿分 100 分。長音依時間取得較多分數，唱準一部分可…

# mesh-to-tiles

把带贴图的 OBJ 或 glTF 网格转成 [3D Tiles 1.1](https://github.com/CesiumGS/3d-tiles) 隐式八叉树。

每个瓦片是一个 Draco 网格加一张重烘焙的图集。最精细一层为 4096 像素，从原图采样；更粗的层级逐级减半，最低 128。图集默认编码为 KTX2 ETC1S。

## 核心特性

| 特性 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| OBJ / glTF / GLB → 3D Tiles | 隐式八叉树，按模型包围盒自动生成 LOD，`refine` 为 `REPLACE`。GLB 可含 Draco |
| 单张图集 | 每个瓦片重烘焙一张图集，UV 岛按原贴图重排；最细 4096，向上逐级减半，最低 128 |
| Draco 几何压缩 | 使用 `draco3dgltf` 编码，输出符合 `KHR_draco_mesh_compression`，材质 unlit、双面 |
| KTX2 纹理压缩 | 默认 ETC1S（Basis Universal，质量 128，无 mipmap），符合 `KHR_texture_basisu`；`worker_threads` 并行编码。`--no-ktx2` 改为 PNG |
| 地理定位 | 经度、纬度、椭球高定位局部原点 `(0,0,0)`。`--up` 表示输入模型的向上轴 |

## 技术栈

| 部分 | 使用 |
| --- | --- |
| 语言与运行时 | TypeScript，Node.js 18+ |
| glTF 读写与 Draco | `@gltf-transform/core`、`extensions`、`functions`，`draco3dgltf` |
| 贴图缩放与采样 | `sharp` |
| KTX2 | `@loaders.gl/textures` 中的 Basis Universal WASM，`worker_threads` 并行 |
| 瓦片格式 | 3D Tiles 1.1 implicit octree，`KHR_draco_mesh_compression`，`KHR_materials_unlit`，可选 `KHR_texture_basisu` |

KTX2 编码在 CPU 上完成。Cesium 加载时再把 ETC1S 转成当前显卡的块压缩格式。

## 环境

- Node.js 18 或更高
- 带贴图的 `.obj`（含 `.mtl` 和 `map_Kd`），或带底色贴图的 `.glb` / `.gltf`

## 安装

```bash
npm install
npm run build
```

直接运行：

```bash
node dist/cli.js --input model.obj --output ./tiles
```

## 发布包

其他项目不需要安装 Node，也不需要再执行 `npm install`。按平台各打一份：

```bash
npm run pack:win
npm run pack:linux
```

产物在 `release/mesh-to-tiles-win-x64` 和 `release/mesh-to-tiles-linux-x64`。目录里的 `node`、`sharp` 和 WASM 要一起拷贝。Linux 包在 glibc 系统上使用，例如 Ubuntu。

Windows：

```text
mesh-to-tiles.cmd --input model.obj --output ./tiles --longitude 109.40 --latitude 34.03 --height 0
```

Linux：

```bash
chmod +x mesh-to-tiles
./mesh-to-tiles --input model.obj --output ./tiles --up z --longitude 109.40 --latitude 34.03 --height 0
```

或链接到全局命令：

```bash
npm link
mesh-to-tiles --input model.obj --output ./tiles
```

## 用法

```bash
mesh-to-tiles --input model.glb --output ./tiles --longitude 109.40388330 --latitude 34.03154500 --height 0
```

`--up` 只描述输入模型的向上轴，不改变输出方向。OBJ 默认 `z`，glTF / GLB 默认 `y`。ODM 导出的 OBJ 和 GLB 顶点都是 Z 轴向上，OBJ 可以不写，GLB 要写 `--up z`。

输出固定为两套坐标：瓦片局部坐标是 Z 轴向上、单位米；瓦片内的 glTF 按规范写成 Y 轴向上，Cesium 加载时会转回 Z 轴向上。`--longitude`、`--latitude`、`--height` 是局部原点 `(0,0,0)` 的大地坐标，不会从网格里读取。`--height` 是该原点的 WGS84 椭球高，不是离地高度。顶点原来的 Z 会保留。

### 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--input` | `.obj`、`.glb` 或 `.gltf` | 必填 |
| `--output` | 输出目录，每次运行会先清空 | 必填 |
| `--up z\|y` | 输入模型的向上轴 | OBJ 为 `z`，glTF / GLB 为 `y` |
| `--leaf-size` | 最细格子边长，米 | `40` |
| `--leaf-error` | 最细层级的 `geometricError`，米 | `1` |
| `--max-levels` | 层级数上限 | `6` |
| `--longitude` | 局部原点经度，度 | 不写 |
| `--latitude` | 局部原点纬度，度 | 不写 |
| `--height` | 局部原点椭球高，米 | `0` |
| `--no-ktx2` | 图集保持 PNG，不编码 KTX2 | KTX2 开启 |

经度和纬度要么一起传，要么都不传。

## 输出

```text
tiles/
  tileset.json
  tiles/{level}/{x}/{y}/{z}.glb
  subtrees/0/0/0/0.subtree
```

`tileset.json` 为 3D Tiles 1.1，`subdivisionScheme` 为 `OCTREE`，`refine` 为 `REPLACE`。一个 subtree 覆盖全部层级。glTF 内容为 Y 轴向上、unlit、Draco 压缩。底色贴图默认为 `image/ktx2`，并声明 `K…

# 老哔拾课

> 老哔拾课，你值得拥有。

## 哔站拾课 · 初版（完整功能）

把 B 站课程视频，变成可复习、可检索、可对话的笔记。

这是「哔站拾课」的初版源码快照，包含 Web 前端与 FastAPI 后端，可直接作为 GitHub 仓库初始版本。

## 功能

- 粘贴 B 站视频链接，生成结构化课程笔记
- **B 站合集 / 多 P 自动识别**：识别「149 P」、合集、UP 主系列
- **批量生成**：全选 / 只选未生成 / 选范围，一键加入队列
- **批量并发 1 / 2 / 3** 可选
- 本地 faster-whisper 转写（支持 CUDA，失败自动回退 CPU）
- 转写原话「整理」：去除口头废话，保留时间戳
- 笔记 / 整理 / 思维导图 / AI 问答四个阅读 Tab
- AI 问答：RAG 检索、SSE 流式输出、引用来源可跳转
- 多模型供应商管理（OpenAI 兼容接口）
- 笔记分组、改名、移动、导出 Markdown
- **分组一键下载全部 Markdown（ZIP）**
- 笔记库 / 任务页：每页 50 条，支持上一页 / 下一页
- 任务页：按分组折叠，可一键全部收起；进行中 → 未开始 → 已完成
- 视频区：查看 / 清理音频、视频、截图缓存
- 五套主题：Cobalt、国风、Claude 暖纸、天空蓝、宫崎骏风·森系
- 顶部搜索（⌘K / Ctrl+K）直达搜索页
- 笔记正文：表格样式、章节大纲、KaTeX 公式渲染
- 任务页真实阶段日志

## 技术栈

- 前端：Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript + Pinia + Tailwind CSS 4
- 后端：Python 3.11 + FastAPI + SQLite + SQLAlchemy
- 下载：yt-dlp
- 转写：faster-whisper / CTranslate2
- 向量检索：ChromaDB
- 公式：KaTeX；思维导图：markmap

## 目录

```
backend/
  app/            FastAPI 应用
  skills/         笔记生成 Skill
  tests/          pytest
  main.py         后端入口
BillNote_frontend_vue/
  src/            Vue 前端
start_local.bat   Windows 一键启动
.env.example      环境变量示例
```

## 环境要求

- Python 3.11+
- Node.js 20+
- FFmpeg（仓库已附带 Windows 版：`tools/ffmpeg/bin/ffmpeg.exe`）
- GPU 转写可选：torch 2.7.1 + CUDA 12.8（安装方法见 `tools/README.md`）

## 工具

- `tools/ffmpeg/bin/ffmpeg.exe`：Windows x64 FFmpeg，可直接使用。
- `tools/README.md`：FFmpeg 配置、torch GPU 安装、GitHub LFS/Releases 说明。
- torch CUDA wheel 已放在 `tools/torch/`（约 3.05 GB），不能直接提交普通 GitHub 仓库；请作为 Release 资产上传或使用 Git LFS，详见 `tools/README.md`。

## 启动

### Windows

```bat
start_local.bat
```

默认后端 `http://127.0.0.1:8484`，前端 `http://localhost:3017`。

### 手动启动

```bash
# 后端
cd backend
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py

# 前端（另开终端）
cd BillNote_frontend_vue
npm install
npm run dev
```

首次使用：

1. 打开 `设置 → 模型服务`，添加 OpenAI 兼容供应商、Base URL、API Key
2. 在 `设置 → 转写引擎` 下载 Whisper 模型
3. 回首页粘贴 B 站视频链接生成笔记

API Key 只保存在本机 SQLite 中，不会写入代码或仓库。

## 配置

复制 `.env.example` 为 `.env` 按需修改。常用项：

- `WHISPER_MODEL_SIZE`：`tiny` / `base` / `small` / `medium` / `large-v3`
- `YDL_CONCURRENT_FRAGMENTS`：下载分片并发
- `VIDEO_MAX_HEIGHT`：截图场景视频最高分辨率
- `NOTE_OUTPUT_DIR`：笔记结果目录
- `TASK_MAX_WORKERS`：全局任务并发，默认 3

## 说明


- 初版聚焦 B 站 Web 端；浏览器扩展与桌面端在后续版本。
- 请遵守 B 站服务条款与版权规定，仅用于个人学习。

# stem-explainer-video

> 用 AI 做**结构准确**的 STEM 科普视频。 适合Vibe知识大赏和老师课件制作短视频。

给一个科学原理，产出一条**图准、字对、声音清楚**的讲解视频。 记住！ 这是严肃严格的科学作图和动画！

 
**看效果**：[`examples/heart-ai/heart-ai-route.mp4`](./examples/heart-ai/heart-ai-route.mp4)
（28 秒竖屏成片，3 拍里只有 1 拍用了 AI 视频）


B站视频： 

https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1mWxX6ZEHX/?vd_source=86926e418c83af75f6850b5546388a79


安装：直接复制本 项目链接给你的AI则可以， 装 https://apiz.ai 的 apiz-cli 作为生图生视频的后端。



---

## 这个 skill 解决什么问题

做科普视频最容易踩的三个坑：

| 坑 | 表现 | 本 skill 怎么解 |
|---|---|---|
| **图不准** | 剖面图画成了另一个结构，箭头方向反了 | 底图交给最擅长画结构的中文生图模型，提示词有强制规范 |
| **动坏了** | 视频一生成，原图的结构和标签全变形 | 用底图当**首帧**驱动动画，实测结构 100% 保真 |
| **字幕错字** | AI 把中文标签改成乱码 | 字幕完全不交给 AI，由代码确定性渲染 |

还有一个大多数人会踩的坑：

| 坑 | 表现 | 本 skill 怎么解 |
|---|---|---|
| **烧钱** | 每拍都生成 AI 视频，一集花掉十几块 | **动效分层**：只有「运动本身是知识点」的拍才用 AI，其余 0 成本 |

做法是把视频拆成四层，每层只干自己擅长的事：

```
第 1 层  底图    AI 生图      画出结构准确的中文示意图
第 2 层  动画    MiniMax H3   以底图为首帧，让它动起来
第 3 层  文字    Remotion     用代码叠加字幕/术语卡/标注
第 4 层  旁白    apiz speak   配音
```

---

## 快速开始

### 0. 检查环境

```bash
python scripts/lib_apiz.py
```

会打印 apiz 位置、鉴权状态、余额。看到「鉴权: OK」就成了。

### 1. 复制示例

```bash
cp -r examples/pipe-valve my-episode
cd my-episode
```

### 2. 改 plan.json

这是**唯一要改的文件**。里面写清楚每一拍讲什么、画面长什么样、什么在动。

```json
{
  "id": "s01",
  "duration_sec": 7,
  "narration": "打开你家卫生间的水龙头，水就顺着管道流出来了。",

KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop.content:
# Agent Autoloop

**让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。**

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)

![架构图](docs/architecture.svg)

## 它解决什么问题？

平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。

**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。

- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。

## 上手

支持 macOS 和 Linux。运行前需要装好 Node 24、Git、curl，以及任意一个你已经登录好的命令行 Agent，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以直接把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)丢给你的 Agent，让它替你装好。

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```

装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：

```bash
agent-autoloop try
```

下面是在终端里的真实输出：

```text
事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活……

Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。

【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色
这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。
  1. 蓝色
  2. 绿色
回答：agent-autoloop answer 1 <序号>
答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```

交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近 7 天的轮数、Token 和费用（[统计口径](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#看情况回答)）。

## 一件事怎么转起来

编号和上面的架构图一一对应：

1. **新事件进来。** 早上 9 点的定时任务、GitHub 上新提的 Issue、业务系统报的错，都变成一条标准事件送进内核。
2. **按规则派活。** 内核照你写的规则，决定交给哪个 Agent、去哪个目录干。同一件事排队时又来的消息，会合并成一轮处理。
3. **干完一轮就退出。** Agent 把结果写在最后一条回复里，进程直接退出。
4. **拿不准才问你。** 碰到删数据、重启服务、花钱、对外发消息这类事，内核通过飞书或桌面通知发一张卡片给你。等你回复期间，它不占后台进程，也不消耗 Token。
5. **点一下，接着干。** 你选完，它接上原来的对话，把剩下的活干完。

能自己搞定的事走图上方的自动闭环：直接办完，或者约个时间（比如半小时后）再醒来复查，全程不打扰你。

## 日常怎么配？

### 写一份规则（`rules.json`）

不需要写胶水代码。打开 `~/.agent-autoloop/rules.json`，在 `rules` 里写清楚**什么事、交给谁、在哪个目录干**。`to` 填 `agents` 里已有的名字。比如每天早上 9 点写早报：

```json
{
  "name": "早报",
  "when": { "cron": "0 9 * * *" },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/notes",
  "prompt": "整理昨天的笔记和提交，写今天的早报。"
}
```

外部事件写法一样，只是要先接好来源。比如有人提新 Issue 时交给 Codex，先按[说明](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#接一个事件插件)在 `sources` 里登记 `github`：

```json
{
  "name": "处理 issue",
  "when": { "source": "github", "types": ["issues.opened"] },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/code/app",
  "skill": "handle-issue",
  "parallel": 3
}
```

保存后几秒内自动生效，可以运行 `agent-autoloop check` 检查。就算改错了，系统也会继续按旧规则跑，并发卡片提醒你哪里写错了。

### Agent 怎么跟中台配合？

中台对 Agent 只有一个约定：**在最后一条回复里交代结果**。事情办完了，正常输出一句结论就行。需要向你请示时，在回复末尾附一段 `agent-autoloop` 代码块：

````text
订单已经核对完毕，库存充足。

```agent-autoloop
{
  "ask": [{
    "title": "怎么发货？",
    "text": "两种方式今天都能发出。",
    "options": ["快递", "自提"],
    "key": "shipping"
  }]
}
```
````

除了提问（`ask`），还能发通知（`notice`）、关闭已解决的卡片（`resolve`）、预约复查（`later`）和触发新事件（`events`）。万一 JSON 写错了，中台只让它在原会话里重写最后这段回复，不会把已经干完的业务重做一遍；重写也失败时，保留原结论并通知你回执没有生效。

## 拿来即用的场景模板

每套模板都带规则、任务 Skill 和启用说明。

| 想做什么 | 已经封装好的流程 |
|---|---|
| [每日早报](examples/recipes/morning-brief/README.md) | 默认每天 8 点整理本地笔记和 Git 提交，写入 `briefs/YYYY-MM-DD.md` |
| [跟进 GitHub Issue](exa…

知了 · Cicada

任何会议、任何直播，没有语言障碍。
听得懂，说得出，记得住。Mac 上的实时纪要、双语文字记录、字幕与同声传译。

 

简体中文 · English

无论是用 Zoom、飞书、腾讯会议开会，还是听 X Spaces 和 YouTube 直播，知了都能实时给出双语字幕、边听边写结构化纪要。遇到需要发言的时候，按住键盘右边的 `⌥` 键开口，对方就能在会里直接听到翻译好的语音。这一切都靠直接读取 Mac 系统声音并在本机识别来完成，声音不出电脑，不用往会里塞机器人，对方更是完全无感。

## 主要功能 ### 实时纪要与双语文字记录 开会时纪要窗口边听边整理总结、议题要点、结论、待办、鱼骨图和人名术语表，点一下结论或待办就能跳回双语文字记录里的原话。纪要会统一文中人名和术语的写法并记下听错的变体，按 `⌘F` 搜索时能连同识别错的写法一起搜出来。 ### 实时字幕与语言识别 对方开口几秒钟就能在本地自动认出语言并翻成你的系统语言，按 `⌃⌥S` 可以在纪要窗口、字幕条和不显示之间切换。字幕条只在有人说话时出现，鼠标划过时自动变透明，不会挡住底下的按钮。 ### 同声传译 按住键盘右边的 `⌥` 键说话，对方在会议软件里就能直接听到翻译后的语音，打开同声传译时知了会自动把系统麦克风切到一键安装的虚拟驱动 BlackHole 2ch。填了 Ling API key 后可以用自然人声或用 8 到 30 秒录音克隆你自己的声音，不填也能用 Mac 自带语音。

### 会议记录 每场会议的双语文字记录、纪要和原始录音都保存在本机，打开实验性的说话人识别后还能区分对方不同的说话人并在有 Ling key 时填上名字。会议软件挂断或 10 分钟没人说话时会自动结束并截掉空白，会后随时可以补生成纪要，或导出成 Markdown、Word 和 SRT 字幕。目前记录里的你只包含按住说话键说的话，会上直接开口的部分见[路线图](#路线图)。

## 隐私与权限 声音采集、语言识别、语音识别（Apple SpeechAnalyzer）和会议录音全部在本机完成。会离开电脑的只有识别出来的文字（发去做翻译和生成纪要），以及填了 Ling API key 并按住说话键用同声传译时你说的那几句语音。不填 API key 时，实时字幕、翻译（走 Google 或退回 Apple 本机翻译）、会议记录和同声传译都能正常用。实时纪要、一步语音翻译和声音克隆需要你自己的 Ling（蚂蚁集团的大模型服务）API key（配置方法见[下文](#配置-ling-api-key)），开一小时会大约花 0.15 到 1 元人民币，Ling 每月赠送 10 元额度，约够 10 到 50 小时会议。 知了只在用到某项功能时才请求对应的权限，拒绝后其他功能照常可用。 | 权限 | 用来做什么 | 什么时候问 | 不给的话 | |---|---|---|---| | 录制系统声音（屏幕与系统录音） | 听 Mac 正在播放的声音来出字幕，不录屏幕，也不听知了自己的声音 | 新手引导第一步，或第一次开始听 | 字幕和纪要都用不了 | | 麦克风 | 只在你按住说话键时录音，用来做同声传译 | 打开同声传译时 | 只是不能说话翻译 | | 输入监控 | 只用来判断右 `⌥` 是否被单独按下（只监听、不拦截、不记录别的按键） | 第一次用右 `⌥` 说话时 | 在设置里改成 `⌃`/`⌘` 组合键，就不需要这个权限 | | 管理员密码 | 安装虚拟麦克风 BlackHole 2ch，并重启系统音频服务 | 在引导或设置里点“安装”时，只问一次 | 不能让对方听到翻译，其余照常 | - **联网与虚拟麦克风**。只有翻译（`translate.googleapis.com`）、填了 key 后的 Ling / Ming（`api.ant-ling.com`）、下载 BlackHole 驱动和每天去 …

# terminal-mac

A separate macOS desktop for computer-use agents, viewed and controlled from a terminal.

**iOS simulators and iPhones:** see the sibling project [terminal-phone](https://github.com/govijr/terminal-phone).

`terminal-mac` is an early release candidate for Apple silicon. Apple Virtualization runs a real macOS guest. A bundled helper **inside that guest** captures its screen and posts input events. A terminal viewer streams that screen using Kitty or iTerm2 graphics. Agent commands use the same helper without moving the physical Mac's pointer or changing its clipboard.

The guest is a separate Mac: it has its own apps, files, accounts and permissions. It does not inherit your running host apps or signed-in sessions. The VM still consumes host CPU, memory and storage.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac, macOS 14 or later.
- No development tools are needed for a prebuilt release. Maintainers need Xcode 16 or later / Swift 6 to build.
- Internet on first run to download macOS directly from Apple, or an existing compatible `.ipsw`.
- Space for the cached restore image and a growing VM disk (64 GiB logical size by default).
- Ghostty, Kitty or iTerm2 for the inline viewer. Other terminals can use the native VM window and agent CLI. tmux passthrough and automatic terminal splits are not implemented.

## Install and run

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/govijr/terminal-mac/releases/latest/download/get.sh | bash
```

The installer downloads the latest release and verifies its SHA-256 before installing. You can also extract a release ZIP and run `bash install.sh` from it.

The installer places one launcher in `~/.local/bin` and the bundled runtime under `~/.local/lib/terminal-mac`. Add `~/.local/bin` to your PATH to use simply `terminal-mac`. It needs no administrator rights and does not edit your shell configuration. `bash install.sh --prefix /absolute/path` selects another location.

Running `terminal-mac` in an interactive terminal starts the guided flow. `terminal-mac up` does the same explicitly. It automatically downloads/caches a compatible Apple restore image, installs a virtual Mac, boots it and checks the guest helper. Later runs reuse the existing VM and reconnect. Unsupported terminals get the native desktop window.

**Current status:** early release candidate. Releases are self-signed (no Apple notarization), which the curl installer doesn't need. Live guest acceptance on a clean Mac is still pending.

## Use with agents

terminal-mac gives agents computer use in a separate virtual Mac, through MCP tools (`screenshot`, `click`, `drag`, `scroll`, `type`, `key`, `status`) and a skill that teaches the observe → act → verify loop.

**Claude Code**, with the MCP server and skill in one plugin:

```text
/plugin install terminal-mac --marketplace govijr/terminal-mac
```

Or add them separately:

```sh
claude mcp add terminal-mac -- terminal-mac mcp
terminal-mac skills install                 # → ~/.claude/skills/terminal-mac/SKIL…

zortos293/Lichii.content: # Lichii Lichii is an experimental, open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator written in C++. It builds on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, preserving their contributions while developing this fork's game compatibility and renderer fixes. This is an independent fork, not an official release of those upstream projects. Lichii is not affiliated with Nintendo. ## Downloads and setup Published builds belong on this fork's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Eglantine/releases). The repository still uses its historical Eglantine name; the desktop application is now Lichii. On Windows, extract the entire build archive and run **lichii.exe**. Only use games and system files you have legally obtained. Games, keys and firmware are not included. ### Existing saves and settings The rebrand intentionally retains the existing Eden/Eglantine data directories and configuration keys. It does not move or delete saves, settings or shader caches. Back up your saves before testing experimental builds. ## Compatibility and issue reports Compatibility and performance vary by game, hardware and driver. # cca-bid-planner

Read-only bid planner for Uniswap Continuous Clearing Auctions (CCA). Give it an auction, a budget and a demand assumption, and it returns a bid schedule, with expected fill, average price, worst case and refund exposure for each scenario.

**Website and planner: [cca-bid-planner.vercel.app](https://cca-bid-planner.vercel.app)** · [Docs](https://cca-bid-planner.vercel.app/docs) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

[![ci](https://github.com/cocoa-butter/cca-bid-planner/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/cocoa-butter/cca-bid-planner/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-brightgreen)

![Demo: the planner page switching between flat, top-weighted and bottom-weighted schedules](docs/assets/demo.gif)

CCA is a uniform-price auction run in continuous time. The obvious strategy, one bid at your maximum price, works against you here:

- It fills at whatever the market clears at.
- It is outbid the moment demand passes your cap.
- It tells you nothing about how much of your budget comes back as a refund.

The right ladder depends on how much demand you expect from other bidders. Nobody publishes that number, so this tool makes you state it as an assumption and shows what happens under it.

It never holds keys and never signs anything. The `calldata` command encodes `submitBid` arguments for you to review and send with your own wallet.

## Install

```sh
# run without installing
npx github:cocoa-butter/cca-bid-planner --help

# or install the command
npm install -g github:cocoa-butter/cca-bid-planner
cca-bid-planner --help
```

Not yet published to the npm registry. Installing from GitHub builds the package on install.

Requires Node 22 or later. viem is the only runtime dependency.

## Commands

| Command    | What it does                                                                                                              |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `list`     | Lists live and upcoming auctions on a chain (`--all` adds ended ones).                                                    |
| `inspect`  | Reads parameters and live state and prints a risk report. Every figure is labelled. `--save file.json` stores a snapshot. |
| `plan`     | Builds a bid schedule for `--budget` and `--max-price`, then simulates it under four demand scenarios.                    |
| `simulate` | Replays a given schedule (`--bid price:amount` or `--schedule plan.json`) against one scenario.                           |
| `calldata` | Emits `submitBid` calldata, with `prevTickPrice` hints and Permit2 or msg.value notes.                                    |
| `verify`   | Runs parameter sanity checks. Exit code 3 means a critical check failed.                                                  |

# Hikvision CCTV — CVE-2017-7921 Proof of Concept **Authorized security assessment tool for Hikvision camera and NVR devices**
--- ## Overview This project is a single-target proof of concept (PoC) for assessing exposure to **CVE-2017-7921**, an authentication-bypass vulnerability affecting certain Hikvision IP camera and NVR firmware. The script attempts to retrieve a device configuration file and, when the returned data matches the format implemented in this PoC, decrypts and parses it to identify administrator records. It can also attempt to retrieve a JPEG snapshot through the device's snapshot endpoint. This tool is intended strictly for **authorized security testing**, such as assessing devices you own or systems for which you have explicit written permission. > **Important:** A successful HTTP response does not, by itself, prove that a device is vulnerable. Firmware behavior, endpoint availability, configuration format, and device model can affect the result. ## Features - Tests a single camera or NVR host. - Checks a small set of authentication tokens used by this PoC. - Requests the device configuration endpoint. - Attempts to decrypt configuration data using the AES-128-ECB and per-file XOR steps implemented in the script. - Searches the decoded configuration for administrator records. - Masks discovered password values by default. - Offers an explicit option to display full password values. - Optionally saves the decoded configuration. - Can attempt to retrieve a JPEG snapshot. - Supports configurable port and request timeout. ## Technical workflow At a high level, the script performs the following operations: 1. Builds an HTTP request to the target device. 2. Tries the predefined authentication tokens against `/System/configurationFile`. 3. # youtube-translate-skill

A self-contained **agent skill**: give it YouTube links (videos, channels, playlists) or local
folders/files, and the calling model produces **translated subtitle files** (`.srt`) ready to upload to
YouTube — in several languages at once (default `en, uk, de, fr, es, pl`).

It needs nothing beyond **`python3` (stdlib only)** + **`yt-dlp`** + **the calling model**. An
OpenAI-compatible endpoint is an optional accelerator, not a requirement: in *agent mode* the model that
runs the skill does the translation itself.

## Install as a skill
Copy the folder into your agent's skills directory:

| Agent | Skills directory |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills/youtube-translate/` |
| Codex | `~/.codex/skills/youtube-translate/` |
| omp | `~/.agents/skills/youtube-translate/` |
| generic | any folder your harness scans for `SKILL.md` |

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<you>/youtube-translate-skill
cp -r youtube-translate-skill ~/.claude/skills/youtube-translate   # adjust path per table
```
Then ask your agent to "translate <YouTube link or folder> into <languages>". `SKILL.md` carries the
full instructions the model follows (both modes and the agent loop).

Standalone (no agent) works too — just call the scripts directly as shown below.

## Requirements
- `python3` ≥ 3.8 (standard library only — no pip installs).
- `yt-dlp` on PATH for YouTube inputs: `pipx install yt-dlp` or `brew install yt-dlp`.
- Optional, for local media without subtitles: one of `faster-whisper`, `mlx_whisper`, or the `whisper` CLI. If none is installed, such items are marked `needs-asr` and skipped (the rest of the run continues).
- Optional: an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint for Mode A.

## Quickstart

### Mode A — OpenAI-compatible endpoint
```bash
export YT_TX_BASE_URL=http://<host>:<port>/v1 YT_TX_API_KEY=<key> YT_TX_MODEL=<served-model>
python3 scripts/yt_translate.py run \
  "https://www.youtube.com/@SomeChannel" --latest 10 --langs en,uk,de --out ./out --concurrency 8
```
Env falls back to `OPENAI_BASE_URL` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_MODEL`. The key is never printed.

### Mode B — no endpoint, the model translates (agent mode)
```bash
python3 scripts/yt_translate.py prepare ./my-folder --langs en,uk,de --out ./out
# the agent reads each out/<video>/.work/<lang>/<n>.in.json, writes <n>.out.json beside it
python3 scripts/yt_translate.py status   --out ./out      # what's still pending
python3 scripts/yt_translate.py assemble --out ./out      # validate + write the SRTs
```
Each `.in.json` is a numbered map of source lines plus a `_meta` block naming the source and target
language. The matching `.out.json` must keep the **same numbered keys** (no `_meta`) with **non-empty**
translated strings. See `SKILL.md` for the exact loop.

### Inputs
Mix freely in one call:
- YouTube **video** / **channel** (`@handle`, `/videos`, `/streams`) / **playlist** URLs — `--latest N`.
- Local **folders or files**: `.srt`, `.vtt`, YouTube `…

**[Watch the 35-second demo](docs/media/pyrocade-demo.mp4)** · [Appearance & sound](#library-appearance-and-sound) · [Controller support](#button-prompts)

## Install
Download **PyroCade-Setup-x.y.z.exe** from the [latest release](https://github.com/Pyrodrifter/PyroCade/releases/latest) and run it. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info → Run anyway**.

Installed copies keep their settings, emulators and artwork in `%APPDATA%\PyroCade\data`. PyroCade checks for new releases when it starts and can update itself from the banner or **Settings → PyroCade updates**.

### Linux
Every release has 64-bit (x86_64) Linux builds:

| Distribution | Download | Install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **SteamOS** (Steam Deck) and any distro | `PyroCade-x.y.z-x86_64.AppImage` | In Desktop Mode, right-click the file → Properties → Permissions → *Is executable*, then open it. To play from Game Mode, add it in Steam with *Add a Non-Steam Game*. |
| **Ubuntu**, Debian, Linux Mint, Pop!_OS | `pyrocade_x.y.z_amd64.deb` | `sudo apt install ./pyrocade_x.y.z_amd64.deb` |
| **Fedora**, Nobara, openSUSE | `pyrocade-x.y.z.x86_64.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./pyrocade-x.y.z.x86_64.rpm` |
| **Arch**, Manjaro, EndeavourOS, CachyOS | `pyrocade-x.y.z-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | `sudo pacman -U ./pyrocade-x.y.z-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` |

On Linux, settings and emulators are kept in `~/.config/PyroCade/data`. The emulator downloader installs the official Linux AppImages. The AppImage updates itself; the .deb, .rpm and Arch packages show the update banner and are updated by installing the new package.

On Ubuntu 24.04 and newer, prefer the .deb: AppImages built with Electron need to be started with `--no-sandbox` there because of Ubuntu's AppArmor rules.

## Run from source
    npm ci
    npm start

Build the installer with `npm run dist` (output in `dist/`).

## Releasing an update
Raise `version` in `package.json`, commit, then push a tag `v<version>` (for example `git tag v0.3.0 && git push origin v0.3.0`). The **Release** GitHub Action builds the Windows installer and the Linux packages, smoke-tests Linux, and attaches them to a draft release. Publish the draft, and installed copies offer the update on their next start.

## Brand assets
The flame and play-button mark, glass app icon, wordmark and banner are in `renderer/assets/brand/`. The set includes SVG masters, PNG icons from 16 to 1024px, a transparent wordmark and a multi-resolution Windows `.ico`. The header mark follows the selected colour theme. gxcuit/DNSnitch.content: # 滴水不漏 DNSnitch Clash / mihomo 配置 DNS 泄露检测。 名字的来历：「滴水不漏」是这个工具想帮你做到的事，「滴」也正好念作 D，算是给 DNS 留了个位置。英文名是 DNS 和 snitch（告密者）的合写，泄露的 DNS 就是那个替你告密的家伙。程序名统一用小写的 `dnsnitch`。 开着代理看 YouTube，流量确实走了节点，但运营商照样可能知道你在访问 `www.youtube.com`。问题通常出在配置的几处写法上，它们让本该走代理的域名先在本地查了一次 DNS。下面先说泄露是怎么发生的，再说这个工具怎么用，以及它给出的风险等级怎么理解。 ## DNS 泄露是怎么回事 正常情况下，mihomo 判断 `youtube.com` 要走代理后，会把域名原样交给代理节点，由节点那边去解析。本地网络上不会出现任何关于 `youtube.com` 的 DNS 查询。 如果这个域名在本地被查了一次，哪怕最后流量还是走的代理，收到这次查询的一方也已经知道你要访问 YouTube 了。至于谁能看到，要看查询发给了谁： - 发给 `8.8.8.8`、`223.5.5.5`、`114.114.114.114` 这类明文 DNS：路上的所有人都能看到，包括运营商。 - 发给 `https://223.5.5.5/dns-query` 这类国内的加密 DNS：运营商看不到，阿里、腾讯这些 DNS 服务商能看到。 - 发给 `https://1.1.1.1/dns-query#PROXY` 这种走代理的加密 DNS：本地网络上谁都看不到。 顺便一提，很多教程说把 DNS 改成 `8.8.8.8` 就行了。但 `8.8.8.8` 默认是明文 UDP 查询，路上的人照样能看到你查了什么。 ## 常见的几种写法问题 ### IP 规则没加 no-resolve 这是最常见的一种。mihomo 的规则从上往下匹配，遇到 `GEOIP`、`IP-CIDR` 这类 IP 规则时，如果请求是域名，它得先把域名解析成 IP 才能判断。解析用的是 `nameserver`，而且这时候还不知道这个域名最后走直连还是走代理。 ```yaml rules: - RULE-SET,apple_domain,Apple - GEOIP,private,DIRECT # 没有 no-resolve，走到这一行的域名都会先查 DNS - GEOSITE,youtube,PROXY # youtube.com 在上一行已经被查过了 - MATCH,PROXY dns: enable: true nameserver: - 8.8.8.8 # 明文，youtube.com 被看到 - https://doh.pub/dns-query ``` 给 IP 规则加上 `no-resolve`，或者把 IP 规则都挪到域名规则后面： ```yaml - GEOIP,private,DIRECT,no-resolve ``` 类似的情况还有：把 IP 和域名混在一起的 classical 规则集、引用 IP 规则集时没写 `no-resolve`（比如 `RULE-SET,cn_ip,DIRECT`）、`AND` / `OR` 这类逻辑规则里夹着 IP 条件。道理都一样。 ### nameserver 里混了明文 DNS ```yaml dns: nameserver: - 8.8.8.8 # clash-verge 的默认 DNS 覆写里就有这一行 - https://doh.pub/dns-query - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query ``` mihomo 会同时向这几个服务器发查询，所以后面两个 DoH 等于白配，`8.8.8.8` 那份照样是明文出去的。规则写对的时候它暂时用不上，但只要哪天规则改错一条，就会漏。用 clash-verge 并开了 DNS 覆写的话，机场给的配置本来没问题，也会被这一行改坏。 ### Windows 下开 TUN Windows 默认开着「智能多宿主名称解析」，会同时往所有网卡发 DNS 查询。开了 TUN 以后，Clash 只能拦到发往虚拟网卡的那一份，发往物理网卡的那份直接到了运营商那里。也就是说，系统默认设置下开 TUN，一定会泄露。 专业版可以在组策略里打开「计算机配置 → 管理模板 → 网络 → DNS 客户端 → 禁用智能多宿主名称解析」。家庭版没有组策略，用管理员身份执行下面这条命令，然后重启： ```bat reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient" /v DisableSmartNameResolution /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f ``` ### 其他 - 键名写错，比如 `nameserver-policy` 写成 `nameserver-police`。mihomo 不报错，直接忽略这一段，很难发现。 - 用 `GEOIP,CN,DIRECT,no-resolve` 兜底。加了 `no-resolve` 后，这条规则对域名请求不起作用。 - 没写 `dns.enable: true`。mihomo 默认不启用自己的 DNS，规则需要解析时直接用系统 DNS，也就是明文。 ## dnsnitch 能做什么 这些问题靠翻配置不好找，几百上千行的订阅配置更是看不过来。抓包能确认有没有漏，但看不出是哪一行导致的。所以我写了 dnsnitch，读配置文件直接分析： - 不运行 mihomo，不联网，不改任何文件。 - 判断依据对照过 mihomo v1.19.33 的源码，包括哪些规则会触发解析、查询会发给哪个 DNS。 - 报告会指到具体行号，说明是哪条规则让哪些域名被解析、发给了哪个 DNS，以及怎么改。 - 在 Windows 上还能只读地检查 TUN 有没有真的开着、智能多宿主名称解析有没有禁用。 有命令行和桌面窗口两个版本。 ### 命令行 ```bash dnsnitch check config.yaml # 检查配置 dnsnitch trace config.yaml www.youtube.com # 看这个域名会被哪个 DNS 查到 …

anthropics/FlashProve.content: # FlashProve Version 0.16.0 · A research artifact: not maintained, not accepting contributions. · Apache 2.0 ## What it is FlashProve lets an AI provider prove which model answered a request, without revealing the model's weights. - **Commit.** The provider publishes a commitment ID, which [binds](guide/what-is-proved.md) it to one set of weights. The weights themselves stay secret: every published value that depends on them is masked, except a [declared list](docs/what-is-not-hidden.md). - **Prove.** For each reply, the provider's GPU produces a proof that the reply is the committed model's output. - **Verify.** Anyone can check the proof on an ordinary CPU in seconds with `cp_verify`, without the weights. ## What model it runs FlashProve runs Llama 4 Maverick at full size, with a 1,024-token context window, on a single NVIDIA H100. The prover reaches about 110 tokens/second of prefill at 24 requests per batch ([Performance](guide/performance.md)). ## What is proved The protocol's soundness is proved in Lean 4. A provider that tries to pass off output that is not the committed model's is caught, except with probability about q/2^124 + 2^-101 after q hash queries. [lean/THEOREM.md](lean/THEOREM.md) has the theorem and how to check it. ## Built to be run by an agent Building FlashProve, running it and checking its output take long builds and many exact comparisons. That work is meant for a coding agent. Point yours at this repository with: ```text Read README.md in the FlashProve repository, starting at "For agents", and AGENTS.md. Working from the repository root as an ordinary (non-root) user, build the verifier, check the stored example proof, and report the exit code and last line. Then tell me which other routes (toy proofs on CPU, small model on an H100, full size) this machine can run, and ask me before starting any of them. ``` --- ## For agents Run everything from the repository root as an ordinary user, never as root or under `sudo`. Only installing system packages needs root, so ask your user to do that. If root is the only account, create one first ([how](docs/quickstart.md#install)). Also read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the rules on reporting results. ### Hardware and software | Route | What it does | Needs | Time | |---|---|---|---| | 1. Verify a stored proof | Builds `cp_verify`, checks an example proof | Linux, bash, g++ 13+; under 2 GB RAM | build 1–2 min, check < 2 s | | 2. Toy proofs | Self-test of the proof library on CPU | Route 1, plus make and python3; under 1.5 GB RAM | ~1 min | | 3. UNCUT

The lossless, headless coding agent harness.

One 7 MB static binary, four tools, plain stdin/stdout.
No TUI. No telemetry. No silent context cuts.

Linux · macOS · Windows · amd64 + arm64 · MIT

Landing page: balanov.pro/uncut

[![CI](https://github.com/Balanov/uncut/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Balanov/uncut/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Balanov/uncut)](https://github.com/Balanov/uncut/releases/latest) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![Go](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go-1.26%2B-00ADD8?logo=go&logoColor=white)](go.mod) UNCUT is a tiny coding-agent harness for shell pipelines, CI jobs, containers, and agent experiments. Gezine/CivSwitch.content:
# CivSwitch

XSS toolchain for the Switch 1 edition of Civilization 7.  
Only the **1.0.0** version of the game in physical cartridge is supported.  

Every switch 1/2 firmware 20.x.x and up to current version (23.0.1) should work.  

Tested at Switch 1 fw 22.5.0, Switch 2 fw 20.4.0 and 23.0.1  

Two components:

- **PicoSwitch** — clean, compilable Pico firmware (RP2040 + RP2350) that types a chat-XSS payload into the Switch (USB HID macro).

  Default payload = the Remote JS Loader bootstrap (exploit core + TCP loader).

  Ships with `compress.js` (chat transport: terser -> deflateRaw -> base-25 chunked `img/onerror` lines with censor armor).
- **installer-creator** — given any JavaScript payload, produces the boot-persistent installer (`XSTRIG.Civ7Save` trigger written to savedata) to send through the Remote JS Loader.

## Layout

`core.js` at the root is the shared payload both components build from, and `send_js.py` at the root sends any payload to a running loader.

## Workflow

[Video Tutorial](https://www.reddit.com/r/switch2hacks/comments/1xll4wf/civswitch_hack_start_to_finish/) from switch2hacks reddit

1. **Build + flash** the loader UF2 (see PicoSwitch/README.md).

   On the Switch, go to "System" menu and change system language to English(US).  
   Go to "Controllers & Accessories" menu and change USB Keyboard to English(US).  
   
   These are required to type "English" letters (code) using USB keyboard.  
   (Higher fw might not need to change system language as they support typing english without language change)  
   
   NOTE for JP-only Switch2 : 
   1. If you have another Switch, you can connect the two consoles via local wireless multiplayer and plug the Pico on the other device, allowing it to send the payload over the network.  
   2. If you're on a higher fw version (I'm not sure exact version), you can simply try plugging the Pico and see if it can type English text without changing the system language.  
   
   Connect to Internet using [90DNS](https://gitlab.com/a/90dns) to block Nintendo servers.  
   
   Then launch game and navigate main menu -> MULTIPLAYER -> WIRELESS -> CREATE GAME -> HOST LOBBY -> CHAT then plug the Pico in (in docked mode, focus the chat box first to receive Pico input).  

   The Pico types the chat XSS (~87 lines, ~20 min); the Remote JS Loader comes up on the console (TCP :9026) for that session.  
2. **Install the persistent boot trigger** from the PC: `python installer-creator/install.py <console-ip>` — uploads the save template, splices the compressed payload into it on-console, wipes `save:/saves/Single/`, and writes the trigger.
3. From then on, every boot: main menu -> Load Game -> the payload runs from savedata (and if the payload is the loader, :9026 is up at boot — and survives console sleep/wake).  
4. You can revert system language after installer finished.  

## Sending payloads (`send_js.py`)

```
python send_js.py <console-ip> [port] file.js
```

gongnyang/stickerforge.content:
[한국어](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

# stickerforge

![스티커 시트: 공냥이 캐릭터 24장](docs/assets/hero-sheet.jpg)

캐릭터 이미지 한 장을 넣으면 인쇄용 투명 PNG 스티커 수백 장이 나옵니다. Codex와 Claude Code 양쪽에서 쓰는 스킬입니다.

[![30초 데모 영상 보기](docs/assets/demo-poster.jpg)](docs/assets/demo.mp4)

[30초 데모 영상 보기](docs/assets/demo.mp4)

## 설치

```
git clone https://github.com/gongnyang/stickerforge && cd stickerforge
./install.sh
```

인자 없이 실행하면 Claude Code(`~/.claude/skills`)와 Codex(`~/.agents/skills`, `~/.codex/skills`) 양쪽에 복사합니다. `--claude`, `--codex`로 한쪽만 고르고, 이미 있으면 덮어쓰기 전에 묻습니다(`--yes`로 생략).

플러그인으로 설치할 수도 있습니다.

```
claude plugin marketplace add gongnyang/stickerforge
claude plugin install stickerforge@gongnyang-tools

codex plugin marketplace add gongnyang/stickerforge
codex plugin add stickerforge@gongnyang-tools
```

## 30초 사용법

1. 캐릭터 원본 이미지 한 장과 원하는 장수를 정합니다.
2. Codex 또는 Claude Code에서 말합니다. 예: `$stickerforge 로 이 캐릭터 스티커 100장 만들어줘` (Claude Code에서는 `/stickerforge`).
3. 사람이 세 번 확인합니다. A는 그림체와 장수, B는 시험 생성 결과, C는 최종 시트입니다.

스킬이 작업 폴더(스킬 폴더 밖)를 만들고 `spec.json`, `manifest.jsonl`, `out/`, `qc/`, `export/`를 채웁니다. 중간에 멈춰도 `manifest.jsonl`에서 이어서 실행합니다.

```
python3 skills/stickerforge/scripts/doctor.py          # 환경 확인
python3 skills/stickerforge/scripts/run.py <작업폴더>    # 실행, 재개
python3 skills/stickerforge/scripts/run.py <작업폴더> --status
```

## 동작 단계

| 단계 | 하는 일 | 사람 확인 |
|---|---|---|
| S0 | 의뢰 받기, 그림체 고정 | A: 그림체와 장수 |
| S1 | 컨셉 목록 작성, 전체 목록과 대조해 중복 제거 | 없음 |
| S2 | 시험 생성 | B: 시험 결과 |
| S3 | 양산. 동시 8개 기본, 상한 10 | 없음 |
| S4 | 자동 검수 | 없음 |
| S5 | 불합격분 재생성, 장당 2회까지 | 한도에 닿으면 장수 보고 |
| S6 | 컨택트 시트와 납품 폴더 | C: 최종 |

B 승인 전에는 양산하지 않습니다. 원본 캐릭터 이미지만 참조로 쓰고, 생성물은 참조로 쓰지 않습니다. 그림 위에 글자를 얹지 않으며, 글자가 틀리면 재생성합니다.

## 지원 환경

| 환경 | 상태 |
|---|---|
| Codex 단독 | 됩니다 |
| Claude Code + Codex | 됩니다 |
| OpenAI API 키 | 키가 있으면 쓸 수 있을 거예요 |
| Gemini API 키 | 키가 있으면 쓸 수 있을 거예요 |
| Claude Code만, 키 없음 | 지원하지 않습니다. `doctor.py`가 사유를 알려 줍니다 |

## 자동 검수 항목

`scripts/gates/`의 스크립트가 S4에서 폴더 단위로 PNG를 검사합니다. 종료 코드로 판정하며, 불합격한 장만 S5에서 다시 만듭니다.

| 게이트 | 검사 |
|---|---|
| size | 최소 크기 |
| alpha | 알파 채널과 투명 영역 비율. 알파 12 이하는 0, 240 이상은 255로 정리 |
| checker | 체크무늬가 픽셀에 박힌 가짜 투명 |
| margin | 캔버스 가장자리 여백, 잘림 의심 |
| outline | 외곽선 상태 |
| dup | 세트 안의 중복 |

사람이 하는 시각 검수는 표본 확인이며 전수 검사가 아닙니다. 전수 검사는 게이트입니다.

## 그림체 프리셋

`skills/stickerforge/styles/`에 여섯 개가 있습니다. 기본값은 original-match입니다.

| 프리셋 | 내용 |
|---|---|
| original-match | 원본 그림체를 그대로 유지하고 포즈만 새로 그림 |
| chibi-soft | 큰 머리, 작은 몸, 부드러운 파스텔 |
| flat-vector | 여섯 색 이하의 단색 면, 그라데이션 없음 |
| mono-ink | 잉크 한 색, 단색 인쇄용 |
| toy-3d | 비닐 장난감 같은 부드러운 3D |
| retro-mission-patch | 자수 패치 느낌의 배지 |

![같은 컨셉 두 개를 원본 그림체, 터미널, 흑백으로 그린 비교](docs/assets/style-compare.jpg)

위 비교는 컨셉 두 개(위, 아래 줄)를 왼쪽부터 원본 그림체, 터미널 풍, 흑백 잉크로 그린 것입니다.

## 인쇄 안내

Codex 내장 이미지 도구에는 크기 인자가 없어 결과가 1254-1536px 근처입니다. 300dpi로 인쇄하면 한 변 기준 약 10-13cm입니다(1254px는 10.6cm, 1536px는 13cm). 그림이 캔버스의 70-90%를 차지하므로 실제 인쇄 크기는 이보다 작습니다. 50mm 스티커는 내용 약 590px이면 되어 충분합니다. 100mm를 넘는 큰 스티커는 300dpi에 못 미칠 수 있습니다. 이때 업스케일로 숨기지 않고 실제 dpi를 알려 줍니다. 더…

# 普号注册

纯协议的 Adobe 普号注册机。不打开浏览器，直接按接口建号、登录。

交流 QQ 群：727682537

## 成品

`成品` 目录是可以直接运行的完整程序。双击 `成品/普号注册.exe`。

请整目录一起使用。exe 旁边需要 `data` 和 `runtime`，单独把 exe 拷走开不起来。

第一次打开会检查 Node、Python、协议和设备指纹。邮箱和设置写在 exe 旁边的 `puhao.db`，这个库没有放进仓库。

## 打码

建号时 Adobe 会要求认图。程序把认图交给 YesCaptcha 自动提交，使用前要在界面里填写自己的打码密钥。没有密钥不能开始注册，这一步不是免打码。

代理按行填写。每次注册会换成新的 8 位 SID。

## 导入邮箱

一行一个：

```
邮箱----密码----ClientID----RefreshToken----辅助邮箱----辅助密码
```

## 从源码构建

需要 Go 1.24，在仓库根目录执行：

```
go build -trimpath -ldflags "-H windowsgui -s -w" -o 成品/普号注册.exe ./puhao
```

开发时可以：

```
go run ./puhao --no-open
```

然后打开 http://127.0.0.1:17620/

界面标题栏可以打开积分号购买和本仓库。

把需要的题材文件夹复制到 `~/.claude/skills/`，然后直接发故事点子。

如果你的版本支持导入 Skill，就导入对应文件夹；不支持就按聊天工具的方法整段粘贴。

内容较长，所以分批输出，每批开头标明进度，回复"继续"写下一批。能直接写文件的工具可以连续写完，文件结构写在 `SKILL.md` 第一章。

- **测试状态**：当前版本已在 WorkBuddy 实测通过；此前玄幻修仙版经过实际使用测试，宫斗、宅斗、年代文、系统无限流、总裁甜宠、重生复仇、职场商战做过安装校验或阶段1试跑；其余题材尚未逐一实测。

Airhand

High-performance remote desktop over QUIC · Rust + Tauri + React

English · 简体中文

--- Airhand is a single program that is both the **host** (the computer being controlled) and the **controller** (the computer you control it from). It runs on **Windows**, **macOS** (13 or later) and **Linux** (X11 desktops). A small relay server, deployed with one Docker Compose command, handles signaling and forwards traffic. The controller can also be deployed with Docker Compose as a **web console** that you use from a browser. > **Status:** under active development. The protocol still changes between versions, so the clients and the server must be built from the same version (a mismatch is detected and reported, see [Protocol versions](#protocol-versions)). ## Features - **Host by default**: after launch there is only a tray icon, no window, and no WebView is started - **Controller console**: control **several computers at once**, switch between them, or watch them all in a multi-screen overview - **Web console**: start the controller with Docker Compose and open one port in a browser;
